title: Elemental statuses on a monster, as this phone predicts them
what it tracks: Local per-monster status map: apply, refresh, frame-counted expiry, collision consume, resonance streak and mana restore.
top concern: Phone restores mana and pops +MP on every collision; worker pays only resonating ones. Statuses tick 16.7 ms a pass, not real time.

title: The codex's discovered lists, kept per browser
what it tracks: Four module Sets (collisions, monsters, materials, zones) loaded from localStorage at import, written on first discovery.
top concern: Per-character progress lives per device and is wiped on every character switch; the dashboard codex reads other fields nobody writes.

title: A guild's quest ladder: rung shown vs rung paid
what it tracks: Client _guildProgress picks the shown rung; worker's guild_claims count settles; adopted only from guild_quest_result.
top concern: Worker's claims never reach the phone at join, so a new device or switch shows rung 0 while the worker is on rung n.

title: Deploy-order switches held in the data layer
what it tracks: Module booleans (abilities, block scale, fish heal, t2 bench, grids, t2 simple, gear quality) set from state_sync caps.
top concern: Defaults disagree before first state_sync; one try block means one throwing setter leaves later flags stale.

title: A quest's state for one character and who offers what
what it tracks: rpg._quests per quest: available, active, complete, turnedIn; getNpcQuest decides offers; worker's _questBarred decides acceptance.
top concern: Stored 'complete' has no writer: getNpcQuest skips it, journal says ready, worker refuses its hand-in; offer rules split across sides.

title: Which building doors count as reachable for a quest
what it tracks: Door memo from WORLD_PROPS plus Wheel doors, minus closed zones; invalidated by two setters called at world-mode apply.
top concern: Worker never asks about doors, so a hidden quest can still be accepted elsewhere; no live quest is walled today.

title: This phone's cached character record, migrated and predicted before the worker speaks
what it tracks: bt_rpg boot copy runs five one-time migrations and local XP/level prediction until the worker's full player_state.
top concern: migrateLifeSkills skips four skills and non-object skills the worker heals; stamps live only per browser.

title: The Dungeon Workshop's unlocks: bosses beaten, packs bought
what it tracks: Client-only pack ownership and boss-clear gates for the farm's custom dungeon; the worker sanitizes config, ignores packs.
top concern: Boss-gated packs read dungeonClears keys like ember_mid; the worker writes wheel_verdant/workshop, so they can never unlock.

title: A harvest's wind-up clock (the explicit half)
what it tracks: Timing table and pure schedulers for the harvest attempt: plan wait, hit lead, settle, gesture window, open delay.

title: Client-side factories for dormant or retired systems
what it tracks: Minigame instance status, clan war object, gathering node, market order, pet evolution, anniversary latch; no live callers.
top concern: Dead lifecycle objects beside live ones (depleted vs alive) invite a revival by mistake.

title: The current-zone-size globals
what it tracks: TOWN_W/TOWN_H/COLS/ROWS let bindings reassigned on zone changes, plus a boot-frozen globalThis copy.
top concern: Two copies can disagree; only the NPC wander clamp reads them and skips them in the Wheel.

title: Tables here that drive machines living elsewhere
what it tracks: Ability timings, cue gaps, achievement ids, boss split size, arena poll cadence, drop clocks, combat timing constants.
top concern: Arena poll's _arenaMatch needs a status field today's route never sends; readers rely on _inDuel instead.

title: The comprehensive stats record (compStats)
what it tracks: Client-owned vanity counters with a 60-frame playtime tick and a _sessionStart stamped only at creation.
top concern: Playtime counts frames, so slow phones log less; old SkillsPanel adds now minus creation time as a session.

title: The old map's exits and the World View arrival
what it tracks: Old town and World View exit tables plus the hub exit-disarm deaf window in zoneTransitions.

title: The AudioContext's life and the once-a-second audio watchdog
what it tracks: One audio context through suspended, interrupted, detached and closed; a watchdog wakes, listens and rebuilds it.
top concern: _whenRunning callbacks fire against the NEW context when the old one closes; _rebuildContext's hand-kept reset list already misses several fields.

title: iOS audio-session reclaim and the first-tap kick
what it tracks: Return events arm a session reclaim or a 20 s kick; the next gesture fires it.
top concern: A refused silent-WAV claim re-arms after the context was already rebuilt: two full rebuilds and re-decodes per return.

title: Zone music: which place's track is playing
what it tracks: _currentZoneAmbient plus url, in-flight flag, epoch and source track the zone track across fetch, hold, deck and decode.
top concern: No restart entry point: six callers null _currentZoneAmbient to force one, so each runs the zone-leave side effects too.

title: The session track (login theme) and its duck under a zone track
what it tracks: Start-once session track with an 8 s starting guard, decoded or streamed, ducked under zone tracks.
top concern: 'A zone owns the music' is computed two ways (zone table vs sticky _globalMusicDucked); a failed zone fetch can leave the decoded theme at 0.

title: The zone track's fetch held behind the loading gate
what it tracks: Open/armed/holding latch parks one zone-track fetch until the preload settles or 20 s pass.
top concern: An older gate's settle closure opens a newer gate's hold early (no identity check).

title: The music deck: one streamed audio element and what it should play
what it tracks: One <audio> deck with tokens, pending url, stop fade, gesture wait, proof watch and zone/session/dance wants.
top concern: A single 5 s silent-tap window turns streaming off for the session (decoded fallback, +23-40 MB); _danceWant survives _rebuildContext.

title: A land's air (ZONE_AMBIENT loop) torn down and re-decoded on a same-zone restart
what it tracks: The zoneamb-<land> loop starts on entry, frees its buffer on leave, and rides startZoneAmbient's call.
top concern: A same-zone restart (tab return, unmute, watchdog) runs the leave branch: birdsong, lava or wind cut, refetched, re-decoded and restarted from the top.

title: The sound gate: no world sound under the loading screen or a veil
what it tracks: DOM-observed closed/pending/open gate with a reason, a 60 s loading failsafe, and parked loops.
top concern: Music is gated only through the deck; on the decoded fallback the session and zone tracks play under the loading screen again.

title: Managed sound loops (sizzle, reel, river, the air, beds)
what it tracks: Keyed idempotent loops that callers ensure every frame and stop when their condition lapses.
top concern: The ensure-every-frame contract is the only recovery after _rebuildContext; the once-started zone air has none of its own.

title: A sound's decode life: bytes held, decoding, decoded, evicted (the sound cache)
what it tracks: Per-key sample phases across six maps: file bytes, in-flight decode, decoded pinned or LRU, evicted, cold play.
top concern: Rebuild resets _samples but not _tagLoads/_sampleTag/_sampleLoadP; one refused low-rate decode doubles every later voice's memory for the session.

title: Asks remembered before there is a context: manifest, combat sounds, the Wheel's ground steps
what it tracks: Latches remember sound loads asked before the first gesture; unlock() replays them once a page.
top concern: After any context rebuild (every iOS app switch) the Wheel's ten ground clips are never reloaded: dirt steps and fallback hit/prop voices until re-entry.

title: Menu sounds: one voice a key, and the generic click that yields to a named one
what it tracks: Per-key last-voice slot with a 260 ms window, and a 60 ms deferred click that yields to named sounds.
top concern: A named sound dropped by the 260 ms window never stamps _uiSpecificAt, so the pending generic click plays instead.

title: The voice cap: at most 3 copies of one recording start within 50 ms
what it tracks: Per-key sliding window of start times that holds back crowd copies of one recording.

title: Sample round-robins: which swing, hit, step or stroke plays next
what it tracks: Eight counters and last-one slots alternate samples and detunes for swings, hits, steps, strokes, props.
top concern: propHit's fallback shares _swordHitToggle with materialHit, breaking the promised strict two-step alternation (cosmetic).

title: Mute, the two sliders, and the Sound Studio's music preview
what it tracks: muted, musicLevel and sfxLevel drive two bus gains; the studio preview writes the music bus directly.
top concern: A slider move, mute or rebuild during a studio preview restores the music bus under the preview; skateRollDemo never disconnects its nodes.

title: The procedural drone and combat intensity (dormant since v2.3.1103)
what it tracks: Oscillator drone nodes only ever nulled; setCombatIntensity still called each combat frame and no-ops.

title: NPC_DATA: the seed record of every townsperson's routine
what it tracks: Rows seed alive, hp, timers, targets and quest marker that BroTown's AI loop mutates on shallow copies.
top concern: Client-only townsfolk death and respawn path is unreachable only because every row sets noHp; shallow copies share nested arrays.

title: Which worker generation the page predicts against (caps flags)
what it tracks: About a dozen module flags mirror state_sync caps, rewritten together each sync; prog3Live needs cap and blob.
top concern: Move speed and reach are client-consumed by design; the worker bounds rather than computes them.

title: ZONES as a live table: the Wheel's size and the dungeons' synthetic rows
what it tracks: ZONES.wheel geometry set from caps; dungeon rows inserted on start, dropped by four exit paths.
top concern: A Wheel dungeon's row is deleted by a 1.5 s timer that checks only the id; re-entering the same instance inside it loses the row.

title: One zone-blocker hook shared by the Wheel, the farm and the arena
what it tracks: Single blocker-hook slot installed by whichever world is drawn; its disposer clears only its own.

title: Wheel townsfolk and halls gated by worker caps: halls every sync, townsfolk at spawn
what it tracks: One table gates halls (re-read every state_sync) and cap-needing townsfolk (decided once at spawn).
top concern: A reconnect to a worker with different caps re-gates halls but keeps the spawned Woodworker, Farmer or Beastmaster until a zone change.

title: Pets: the page's mirror of the worker's pet book
what it tracks: Display copies of the pet trade hold, XP curve and wire parse; the worker decides everything.
top concern: With pettrade off the worker answers 'off', which TRAP_WORDS words as trapping resting; petTradeView keeps offering.

title: Monster phases the page treats as nothing to hit (burrow pile, swell deadline)
what it tracks: isIntangible reads _burstUntil and _burPhase, written by events, ticks and the renderer's expiry.
top concern: The page tests !!_burstUntil where the worker tests now < _burstUntil; a missed execute leaves a monster untouchable past its deadline.

title: A gather node's seed: alive, hp, respawnAt and a 2-minute respawn the worker does not use
what it tracks: createGatherNode seeds a node's alive, harvested, respawn machine; guards read respawnAt on the page clock.
top concern: Seed predicts a 120 s revive while the worker revives at 20 s; a lost deplete echo leaves the node greyed for 2 minutes.

title: Lil Bro's tally of races won off you
what it tracks: Module counter of races lost, bumped by race_end, read by his next line; memory only.
top concern: The count is the page's, not the character's: another character in the same tab inherits it.

title: The monster codex's unlock thresholds
what it tracks: Static thresholds for the worker's kill-count codex pages; all facts open at one kill.

title: Animation timelines declared in this slice (level-up burst, zone banner, auras, stage looks)
what it tracks: Frame and beat tables with pure frame-at-time readers driving visual machines elsewhere.

title: Cosmetic masks: owned list and the one worn (dormant)
what it tracks: MASKS and drawMask describe a worn-mask cosmetic; nothing writes rpg._activeMask and nothing calls drawMask.

title: The target lock (who you are fighting)
what it tracks: S.lockedTarget: auto vs tap monster locks, fighter locks, latch, far drop; 38 writers in 12 files.
top concern: Only targeting.js's 8 drops stamp the why and clear the lock's aim; clearLockAim is private, so 30 outside drops cannot.

title: Where the aim came from (_aimSrc provenance)
what it tracks: _aimAngle/_aimSrc/_aiming/_lastAimAngle: who wrote the aim, so a lock's aim dies with the lock.
top concern: A kill's lock clear skips clearLockAim; the stale bearing then draws the sword/bow pose one way while the hit goes another.

title: "I picked this fight" (melee engagement)
what it tracks: _engagedId/_engaged/_engagedGapAt: the tapped monster that keeps the sword auto-swinging after the lock moves.
top concern: Ends only when the chosen monster dies or leaves S.monsters; a far Wheel copy never leaves, so later monsters get unrequested swings.

title: May I attack now? (the held-attack fire gate)
what it tracks: autoAttack/engage/tap-attack drive the loop's shots and swings through one gate; presses use playerActions' own.
top concern: The loop never asks isStaggered: a held attack keeps swinging and sending after a parry the v2.3.3264 contract says sends nothing.

title: A melee swing (start, contact, sweep, end)
what it tracks: isSwinging/swingTimer/_specialAttack/_swingBcastPending/_hitThisSwing: one sword swing's wind, contact, sweep and end.
top concern: A press's first (tapped) swing never raises _swingBcastPending, so peers never see a tapped swing, only a hold's later ones.

title: The bow's sight gate and the queued bow special
what it tracks: _bowSight per frame and _bowSpecialQueued (2.5 s): the bow looses only on a line; a special waits for one.
top concern: The queue is consumed only inside the held-attack gate; the Special button and the flick queue with no thumb held, so it lapses.

title: A player projectile from nock to removal
what it tracks: S.arrows entries: queued, nocked, flying, landing, stuck/burning, planting, planted, in a rock, spent, removed.
top concern: A stuck special holds the monster object, not its id; after a list replace it bills and rides a frozen copy for its whole burn.

title: A monster's shot on its way to you
what it tracks: S.slimeProjectiles: the worker's display-only balls and the dormant local orbs, each ending in one burst queue.

title: The once-per-life remnant pile, in a worker's zone
what it tracks: m._localRemnantDropped: one local remnant pile per monster life, dropped when a monster sits alive at 0 hp.
top concern: Every swelling slime's first life drops a claimable phantom pile beside the worker's; the flag is never reset by the worker's respawn.

title: The sword's local kill, in a worker's zone
what it tracks: The melee kill block (local XP, coin pile, alive=false) has no server-zone gate; the arrow's does.
top concern: Any server monster held alive at 0 hp lets a swing run the single-player kill; v2.3.2226 closed it only for the swelling slime.

title: Other players' damage numbers, held and dripped out
what it tracks: Per-source peer popup queue with an 80 ms release cadence, 600 ms force and a zone-change wipe.
top concern: _peerDmgLastRel is pruned only on a zone change, and the Wheel is one zone (small).

title: Styling your own server-rolled numbers
what it tracks: _ownSpecialRecent (sticky boolean) and _ownCollisionRecent (fresh-checked) dress the worker's number for your hits.
top concern: After one sword special every later own number (arrows, ticks, PvP) is drawn as a special; ranged specials never are.

title: "This monster is after me" flags written by your own hits
what it tracks: m._aggroed/_aggroTs/_chaseUntil/_kbUntil stamped on the worker's monsters by your hits; cleared only by tick tg.
top concern: tg is sent only while targeting (+2 s) and the worker respawn keeps _aggroed, so the reach ring can take a monster not after you.

title: The local monster brain
what it tracks: Client-owned monster AI: aggro, archetype moves, boss idle/telegraph/attack/recovery, telegraph strike, local respawn.
top concern: Dormant; its _invulnerable flag is shared with the live burrow and refuses hits before monster_damage is sent.

title: Dying to a local monster (third copy of death and respawn)
what it tracks: _dying/_deathStart/respawnTimer + a 3.5 s setTimeout teleport, reachable only from a local monster's blow.
top concern: Third copy of the respawn; goes to 'town' without the Wheel trip and cannot be cancelled. Dormant.

title: Use-trained Tier-1 stats
what it tracks: _buildUse tally split on a kill into _buildProg; a threshold raises a T1 stat and sends build_point_earned.
top concern: Stat level-ups and grid points are decided on the phone; the worker recomputes on its word (known, inert under prog3).

title: The periodic local save (every 180 frames)
what it tracks: _rpgSaveTimer frame counter: localStorage bt_rpg plus a syncRpgToServer whose RPC is a no-op.
top concern: A full JSON serialisation thrown away every ~3 s (1.25 s at 144 Hz): btRpc returns null.

title: The ranged attack's pose windows
what it tracks: _bowShotAt/_bowShotAng and _staffCastAt/_staffCastAng/_staffCadenceMs stamped at fire, drawn for a fixed window.

title: Claims against players from a swing (and the dead threat timer)
what it tracks: Per-frame player_attack sends throttled per swing (pvpSwing.js), painted under the same rule; per-shot claims.
top concern: S._pvpThreat is written at three sites and read nowhere: a phase that gates nothing.

title: A sword swing through a townsperson
what it tracks: npc._hitThisSwing, shove and sound; the hp/death/respawn half is unreachable (every townsperson is noHp).

title: Impact rings: the producer's lifetime vs the cleanup's
what it tracks: Rings carry their own duration/startDelay; stateCleanup removes all at a flat 400 ms before the renderer's end.
top concern: The big staff bolt's blast ring is cut at age 0.83, never drawn past ~91% of the radius the worker hits.

title: A worker's monster as drawn: eased position, split arc, hit recoil
what it tracks: renderX/Y easing and snap, the split arc (_popFrom), and the hit recoil/flash windows.

title: The phone's own elemental statuses and collisions, and what they award
what it tracks: Local status clocks and collisions beside the worker's; certificates and the Codex awarded from the local roll.
top concern: Certs and Codex entries can be earned for a collision the worker never resolved, and live only in this browser.

title: Ability cooldown clocks and the predicted stamina spend
what it tracks: Per-ability ready-at stamps the client predicts and the worker owns, reconciled by ability_rejected and the pool echo.
top concern: Both clocks are memory-only; a deploy forgets the worker's cooldowns while the tab keeps its own (deliberate, handoff rule 11).

title: The lunge and the shield bash in flight (dash, deferred strike, swing suppression)
what it tracks: A dash toward the lock, a sword strike deferred to arrival, and a window suppressing the ordinary swing's damage sweep.
top concern: Shield raised mid-lunge is not refused and does not cancel the dash; the strike then lands with blocking:true, the overlap v2.3.2246 forbids.

title: The whirlwind windup (armed ring, strike on the tick)
what it tracks: A one-second armed whirlwind on both sides, cancelled by death, zone change or refusal, struck from the worker's position.
top concern: Worker silently drops a windup on disconnect while the tab plays the full strike look; caps read once at join vs the live kill switch.

title: The shield guard: the client's toggle against the worker's guard break
what it tracks: Guard raised or lowered, sent on every move; the worker drains it, breaks it at zero, latches it 3 s.
top concern: Client BLOCK_COSTS_STAMINA=false: the phone never learns of the worker's 3 s guard break, draws a raised shield, walks at half speed, takes full hits.

title: Sprint (tapped or Shift-held, a predicted stamina drain)
what it tracks: Armed, running or stopped sprint with every exit checked per frame; moves marked sp:1 for the worker to pay.
top concern: Worker refuses sprint steps during a guard break the phone cannot see; clearSprint is a dead export with a misplaced comment.

title: The jump and the double jump's flip
what it tracks: One jump or flip record ended by time, death or zone change, with a rest window and a crossing latch.
top concern: Three hand-kept 'body held' lists: jumpRefusal and the sprint miss the avatar veil and the race hold that the walk honours.

title: The skateboard ride (ask, worker's answer, the phone's own step-off)
what it tracks: Board on/off asked of the worker and answered by ride_state; the phone predicts some exits a step ahead.
top concern: Worker-only exits (a landed hit, duel, harvest, pose, trap) are not predicted, so the phone rolls at 2x for one round trip.

title: The skateboard's rolling loop (decode, play, quiet, free)
what it tracks: One looped wheel sound decoded near the board, played while riding, stopped after 1.5 s, freed after 20 s off.
top concern: free() does not cancel a decode in flight; a late decode re-holds ~0.45 MB until the next tick frees it.

title: The dodge roll, the lunge and the retreat shot
what it tracks: A timed roll window owned by the frame loop, paid on the worker by ability_use, which opens its i-frame window.
top concern: A zone change does not end a roll, so E pressed mid-roll carries the rest of it into the new zone.

title: The swing, the special and the burst
what it tracks: Swing cadence clock, 450 ms swing window, 1.5 s special cooldown, queued bow special and the burst's local cooldown stamp.
top concern: Burst's local cooldown is never un-stamped on a worker refusal; specials fire before the worker's mana answer.

title: The right control's press: tap, hold or drag
what it tracks: A press waits as pending for the tap window, then becomes the held attack, the tap's one attack, or nothing.

title: Climbing the vines and jumping up a rise's face (dormant behind ?climb=1)
what it tracks: Climb, face-crossing jump, drop back and chest on rises that only exist with the ?climb=1 URL flag.
top concern: When shipped: faces are walls only on the phone, and the chest's opened state is client-only.

title: Swimming in the Wheel (in, strokes, out, with hysteresis)
what it tracks: Swimming decided each frame from five probes round the boots with in/out hysteresis, a flip guard and a teleport rule.
top concern: A sprinted flip landing over 200 px from take-off counts as a teleport, so landing in water is silent.

title: Element statuses on the player (chill, freeze, hold, daze, wobble, slow, shove, stagger)
what it tracks: Time-gated statuses from monster_attack/pvp_hit that slow, hold or bar the player's actions, carried out by the phone.
top concern: clearElemStatuses is never called: holds, dazes and a shove ride through a zone change or a respawn (bounded by 5 s).

title: Standing back up: the respawn, the stuck-dead watchdog and the death card
what it tracks: Death to respawn on the client: the worker's messages, their replay, a 20 s watchdog, and the death card.
top concern: Three legacy local stand-up copies remain behind a per-zone !_serverMonsters flag, despite respawn.js's 'one copy' rule.

title: A monster's killing blow (direction and size, for its death's pieces)
what it tracks: Per-monster last blow with merge and freshness windows, read once when its death animation starts.
top concern: _deathBlow is not on monsterCarry's carry lists, so a list replace before the kill drops the blow (visual only).

title: A computer's keys: held keys, one-press guards, double tap, wheel step, weapon keys
what it tracks: Held-key map, per-key one-press guards, double-tap roll and wheel memories, and the 1/2/3 weapon keys.
top concern: Key 2 selects the bow slot with no bow owned (key 3 checks the staff): empty slot, no attacks, persisted on the worker.

title: The Enchanter's gem asks: shield gem, weapon gem, take-out
what it tracks: Module-level pending asks that hold the gem buttons for 4 s until the worker's result, with no opId.
top concern: A shield-gem answer slower than 4 s lets a second tap spend a second gem, which replaces and loses the first.

title: The arm's shield, reported to the worker (worn or carried)
what it tracks: Local equip of the shield reported by id or signature on every change and every join.
top concern: A report sent while offline is dropped; the worker treats the old shield as worn until the next join.

title: The one-bite rule in a fight, and the quick-eat pick
what it tracks: Page mirror of the worker's one instant heal per 15 s while fighting, synced by eat_refused.
top concern: noteEatRefused's fight stamp lasts 10 s while the wait can be 15 s, costing one extra refused round trip.

title: A kill's XP flying to the bar
what it tracks: One-slot rendezvous of a kill and its XP gain, and a token-counted hold on the bar's +N with failsafes.
top concern: One waiting slot: a multi-kill before the gains flies a single label.

title: The straight-in road's veil while your bro's pictures are made
what it tracks: A veil and a pending-wait count holding the world until the avatar's pictures are ready or 20 s pass.
top concern: The hold stops the walk but not jumpRefusal's or the sprint's copies of the held list.

title: Emote moves and held poses: the table that times them
what it tracks: The declared move table (kind, length, pops) driving the once/hold pose machine in interactions.js and poses.js.
top concern: sendMove's death test reads S.player.dead/S._dead, which nothing writes; the next frame ends the pose anyway.

title: The harvest gesture's display chase
what it tracks: Forward-only pose phase and cook loop count kept on the extraction record, advanced once a frame.

title: The bow special's three arrows (one shared volley record)
what it tracks: A volley object electing the burn's owner arrow and the first shove, living with its three arrows.

title: One sword claim per swing against a player
what it tracks: Per-swing claim counter keyed by the swing clock, capped at three tries 90 ms apart, per target.

title: The legs' pace: the held speed quantum with hysteresis
what it tracks: A held quantised ground speed per figure with a dead band, timing the jog loop to the stride.

title: An ability strike's look: bash pose, whirlwind vortex, rings
what it tracks: Short stamped visual windows for a strike, reaped by their renderers and cleared with the zone-local list.
top concern: _whirlFx is reaped only once the vortex sheet has frames; _abilityFx is written and never read.

title: The per-zone loading gate at a hub's exit
what it tracks: S._zoneLoading holds the player frozen at a hub exit while the next zone's art loads, with two failsafes.
top concern: The 15 s cap lets the player in before the Wheel's preload ends; the orphaned load later rewrites the residency flag.

title: The one loading veil and today's town's art hold
what it tracks: One DOM veil shared by the hub gate, town art hold, Wheel trip, dungeon opening and farm hold.
top concern: Each hide checks different owners: a dungeon opening's late hide lifts the death trip's veil, showing unloaded today's town.

title: The trip down today's town's stairs into the Wheel's BroTown
what it tracks: Login, death, dungeon and farm returns auto-walk the player down town's stairs into the Wheel.
top concern: The 30 s clock lets go of the veil but not the trip; a re-armed gate past it loads today's town under the Wheel's veil.

title: The Wheel's ground worker and the trial's ready flag
what it tracks: Ground worker start/ready/linger/stop and the _ready flag that tells the hub gate the Wheel is loaded.
top concern: A stale preload sets _ready true after leaving; a failed worker start is cached while you stay, leaving sea, no doors, no Mayor.

title: Which Wheel the room plays (caps.wheelsize)
what it tracks: Short or 5x Wheel, told by state_sync caps, raced against the worker's build; mismatch reloads the page.
top concern: A second size change within two minutes is swallowed: the phone draws the wrong Wheel while claiming it draws both.

title: The zone change and its wipe, copied into a dozen places
what it tracks: S.currentZone flipped by ~11 paths, each with its own list of zone-local state to clear.
top concern: Wipe lists disagree; respawn, arena entry and dungeon-to-farm skip clearZoneLocalFx despite its 'every clear block' contract.

title: Hub exit gates and the Wheel's safe-ground hold
what it tracks: Deaf trail-head latch, Mayor and unlock gates with banner throttles, level-band consent, Wheel commons clamp.

title: The Test panel's zone warp through the front doors
what it tracks: S._devWarp walks an admin through hub doors leg by leg; needs World View exits.
top concern: Unreachable in the Wheel world: the panel offers only WORLDVIEW_EXITS rows, which are empty.

title: A dungeon run on the phone: ask, open, arena, out
what it tracks: Ten fields across five files track asking, the Wheel's 8 s opening, the arena, the clear and leaving.
top concern: On a computer a second E during the opening replaces the run; the first then lifts the veil and unloads the shared floor.

title: After the clear: thirty seconds to pick up the loot
what it tracks: S._dungeonClear counts 30 s then leaves, only if still in that same run.

title: The phone's own dungeon waves and depth tiers
what it tracks: Pre-v2.3.1127 client-run waves, boss, rewards and depth warps; only against an old worker or behind if(false).
top concern: Dormant: pays coins/XP on the phone and its 3 s warps never check the run is still current.

title: One trip into the Wheel that lands somewhere else
what it tracks: _arriveAt: a 60 s one-shot landing point for the way back from a dungeon or the farm.

title: Each land's own music in the Wheel
what it tracks: Debounced land music: fresh first answer, 1.2 s into a land, 8 s home, race music at once.

title: The sky's hour and the season
what it tracks: Clock-derived day phase and Halloween week, with the Wheel's per-frame always-day override.

title: No man's land on the phone: level, skulls, lock
what it tracks: Mirror of the worker's rings and fight rule plus own/peer skull and lock phases on the phone's clock.

top concern: GameApp still subscribes a bridge that writes chest/legs layers from this bus; debug 'inv mock' dresses the character in unearned armour.

title: The expanded Bag page's dormant Equipped tab and the item card's retired layer pickers
what it tracks: An equipped-cards tab pinned off and two loadout card kinds with no opener.
top concern: If revived, the chestLayers toggle skips the level gate and reveal rule; the tab's Unequip takes off the held weapon's slot.

title: The Bag page's category chips (bagFilterBus)
what it tracks: A five-value module-scoped filter choice for the expanded Bag page, kept across leaving the page.

title: The Gear tab's XP count-up frame loop and its skill-tile landing points
what it tracks: A mount-scoped rAF loop re-rendering while xpLanding counts, and skill tiles registered as XP landing points.

title: Bag unseen-pickup registry (write-only)
what it tracks: Session set of bag keys picked up but not inspected; still written each pickup, read by nothing since BagCompact went.
top concern: Registry grows unbounded and re-renders BottomDashboard per pickup while no badge reads has/count/epoch.

title: Open Hero on a section deep link (heroSectionBus)
what it tracks: One-shot pending request Hero consumes during render; no producer calls request() anywhere.
top concern: Only live writer of laneClosed/selCat; a future caller revives three half-retired paths and setState-in-render.

title: Quest detail selection (questDetailBus)
what it tracks: Which quest page the drill shows; null or stale ids render Quest not found or the done page.

title: Skill detail selection and open epoch (skillDetailBus)
what it tracks: Open/consume epoch and persisted last-viewed skill; open() and selected() have no callers, only select() writes.
top concern: Header promises a persisted outline and deep link that no longer exist.

title: Friend presence: online, grace, away, offline, last seen
what it tracks: Per-friend presence from S.others with a 20 s in-memory grace and a localStorage last-seen map.
top concern: bt_friendSeen never pruned; grace measured from the last render, not the peer's last tick.

title: Friends client store: doc, DM archive, unread, open thread, error slot, migration
what it tracks: Client half of the friend request/accept/DM protocol in module vars and localStorage, archive for a delivered-once backlog.
top concern: friend_error is stored but takeError has no caller, so every friend failure is silent; DMs the worker drops show as sent.

title: Friend portrait cache (pending/ready per friend)
what it tracks: Per-friend {key,url,pending} portrait regenerated when the friend's look key changes.
top concern: Unsequenced async race (the class v2.3.1835 fixed for your own portrait) can store an older look; heals next render.

title: Quest log and journal status mirror (offered, active, ready, done)
what it tracks: Sheet derives each quest's status from rpg._quests plus the client quest.check; the worker owns the transitions.
top concern: Worker's objective refusal returns without _questRefusedEcho (spec says every refusal echoes), so a predicted hand-in stands under v2.

title: Life-skill new level-up dot (seen levels per browser)
what it tracks: localStorage per-skill seen level decides the Skills dot; the Skills page marks all seen on mount.
top concern: A skill with no stamp counts as seen and nothing seeds the map, so a fresh browser never shows the dot before a first visit.

title: Scroll-tap gesture recovery
what it tracks: Per-component gesture record replaying a browser-cancelled touch as a tap when nothing scrolled and travel is under 44 px.
top concern: Any non-scroll pointercancel (long-press callout) also replays as a tap, e.g. arming the points reset.

title: Stat caption whole/short with cut hysteresis
what it tracks: Caption shows the whole stat name or its short form, remembering widths where the browser cut it.
top concern: A cut seen in the fallback font is remembered after the web font loads.

title: Points tab lane shown (picked versus held weapon) and dead lane state
what it tracks: buildCat = a picked lane, cleared when the held weapon's lane changes; laneClosed/selCat/catCard sit beside it unused.
top concern: laneClosed stuck true and selCat/catCard/catGrid unreachable but still computed; rewiring revives code unrun since v2.3.2683.

title: Hero view state: section tab, selected slot, open stat family
what it tracks: Module-persisted section (reset on bar) and stat family (never reset), plus the selected gear slot.
top concern: _lastFam survives every close, so later visits open with a family covering the character, unlike the section.

title: Spend points and stay: batch prog3_allocate and the waiting window
what it tracks: Confirm window sends n allocations, shows Spending, waits for the echo or 3 s, reopens with what landed.
top concern: Each point is an unpaced full blob save plus full player_state on the worker; one tap can be dozens of puts under nostatcap.

title: Free points reset two-tap arm
what it tracks: First tap arms for 4 s, second sends points_reset through a helper with its own dedupe stamp.

title: Stat explainer scene loop (Now and +n on one clock)
what it tracks: Timeline of id-guarded steps on setTimeouts, re-run on fresh dice, fully cleared on unmount or input change.
top concern: Restarts from t=0 each time an async asset lands (up to four times in the first second).

title: Stat scene asset pipeline (figure, attack, moves, pins, films)
what it tracks: Staged async captures with null/false/ready conventions and live guards, freed with the window.

title: Slime pin strips and per-launch-point keyframes
what it tracks: Strip pixels read once and kept; a pins set and injected style per launch point, never removed.
top concern: About 1.8 MB of frame data kept for the session; a style and set per stage width (rotation, resize) never freed.

title: Stat scene fight simulation (worker phases mirrored)
what it tracks: Pure discrete-event mirror of slime attacks, status ticks, guard drain and kills, held by statsim.test.
top concern: Guard pass never shows a break; cannot happen within its two attacks today.

title: Points rule-set mode: legacy blob, prog3 and cap-gated variants
what it tracks: Sheet branches on record shape plus eight caps flags set each state_sync; readers pick their own subsets.
top concern: Eight flags read ad hoc across five files; a cap gap shows the legacy grid whose T2 spend applies and persists client-side.

title: Equipment slots view (worn, ghost, cape REMOVE)
what it tracks: Six cells derived from the rpg echo, the localStorage gear store and the worker-fed cape catalog.
top concern: A cosmetic-only chest or legs layer lights the cell with no stat piece behind it (documented).

title: Band footprint per layout mode
what it tracks: Pure table from orientation, one band, computer column, folded and sheet kind to band height and world width.

title: Character figure canvas (Equipment tab, stat scene)
what it tracks: Draw-on-change canvas keyed by a wardrobe revision and weapon identity, out-of-order draws dropped by __pseq.
top concern: Never redrawn after a parked-tab canvas purge (TRAPS 250) and its 768 px canvases are never emptied; drawn twice per stat window.

title: Identity strip (retired)
what it tracks: Who-am-I row with connection dot and XP strip; band branch returns null and the header branch has no caller.

title: Shared portrait handoff (portraitStore)
what it tracks: One-value store the dashboard fills with your sequence-guarded bust; readers fall back through one chain.

title: The chat composer over your bro: open, closed, stood down under a decision panel
what it tracks: chatBubbleBus.open with five closers and a two-way reconcile against the modal guard; the draft
top concern: Comment promises a guard close keeps the typed draft; every close runs setVal(''), so a trade invite landing loses the half-written line.

title: Dictation mic in the chat composer (idle, listening, thinking)
what it tracks: Web Speech recogniser per dictation: micState idle/listening/thinking and recRef
top concern: Abort runs only on unmount and the composer never unmounts: closing it mid-sentence leaves the mic hot and the words land in the next draft.

title: World Chat corner: the bell vs the open feed, its unread mark and its tap-to-close classifier
what it tracks: Remembered fold flag, newest-shown mark for unread, two tap recognisers, busy and guard stand-down
top concern: Stale comments: shut is the default now, so own sent lines and everything since boot count unread; the remount premise is gone.

title: The Auction House listing chat bus (storeChatBus): additions to P1-17
what it tracks: One open listing's threads and offers, loading and error, plus per-listing unread counts
top concern: 'Opening…' has no timeout or reconnect re-ask, and setErr is not scoped to the open listing.

title: The info popup: open window, stepper count, open chip, and the Spend that stays
what it tracks: One payload holder with per-window stepper and chip state, and a 3.6 s fallback for a staying Spend
top concern: Fallback hands Spend back while the first spend may still be in flight; nothing closes the popup on zone change or death.

title: The old inspect card (InspectCard.jsx + inspectCardBus)
what it tracks: Profile card state; imported but never rendered, opened only by the dead wheel and a debug command

title: The legacy Build (T2) spend screen and its 'Apply 1 point?' confirm
what it tracks: Client-side legacy point spend: confirm bus, local apply, bt_rpg write, stats_update with whole tables
top concern: Client decides the spend and ships the whole allocation for the worker to clamp; only reachable without prog3.

title: Restart character from Settings (idle, confirm, connecting, sending, offline, wipe, reload)
what it tracks: Five-stage restart with a 400 ms reconnect loop, an 8 s fallback reload, and the server's snapshot-and-delete
top concern: The 8 s fallback reload skips the cache wipe the ack path does: a lost ack after a real wipe boots over old caches.

title: The Friends page: view, row menu, open DM thread, and the optimistic DM / Block / Remove sends
what it tracks: Friends, requests and blocked views; one open thread suppressing unread; fire-and-forget friend sends
top concern: Refused or dropped DMs show as sent (friend_error never read); Block on a mutual friend leaves friendship, row and DMs in place.

title: The Pets page: one open row and its sub-step (rename, release ask, sell, Pet House ask)
what it tracks: Row accordion with exclusive sub-steps; every change asked of the worker; one guarded HTTP listing await
top concern: While List is in flight the row's other buttons stay live and its answer closes whatever row is open now; UI flicker only.

title: Feedback: the report's send and the board's up-vote toggle
what it tracks: Four-state HTTP report send and a load/failed board with a per-ticket vote toggle
top concern: Rate limit and votes key on the body's playerId with no token: rotate ids past the limit, or toggle someone else's vote off.

title: Ranks: per-category leaderboard fetch with a 20 s refresh, and the Biggest-fish board's room ask
what it tracks: Per-category cached boards with an alive flag per fetch, and a 30 s fish-board ask to the room

title: Achievements page: filter chip, the opened row, and the title ask's wait (page half)
what it tracks: Filter and one open row over the worker's record; a title ask waits at most 4 s

title: The Codex's monster pages: grid, page, tab, drop card, elder toggle, and the one-shot open request
what it tracks: Grid, page, tab and drop-card navigation, with the NEW MONSTER card's one-shot request to open a kind
top concern: Unkeyed Page: switching the open monster keeps the old page's tab, elder form and drop card, and does not scroll to top.

title: The Codex stage: strips loading (baked, revoked) and the beat loop
what it tracks: Strip load holder baking blob URLs revoked on change, and a setTimeout beat chain with a live flag

title: The nav rail's tap decision (open, rest, sideways dashboard; unfold the band)
what it tracks: Maps button, dashboard mode and orientation to a dashboardPanelBus move
top concern: Documented toggle tapDestination is dead; re-tapping a lit destination re-opens its root instead of resting.

title: Life Skills page: the in-page skill detail and the level-up seen marks
what it tracks: One-shot open of a skill's detail, and a per-browser seen-levels record written on mount
top concern: bt_skillsSeenLv is per browser, not per character: a second or restarted character is compared with another's levels.

title: Quests pages: the journal list, one quest's page, and Track (page half)
what it tracks: Read-only journal views with one write, the tracked quest

title: The chat lane chips: the UI half of G5-1
what it tracks: Chips set the lane mode and whisper name held in chatChannel.js
top concern: A mode whose lane dropped out lights no chip, shows All's hint and keeps the old lane's placeholder (adds to G5-1).

title: The read-only dashboard pages (Clan/Party, Guild, Journey, Self, Stats, Map, About, Login Key, daily line, columns)
what it tracks: Mount, redraw-interval, unmount views over others' records; the Clan page switches on caps.clanparty
top concern: Self, Stats and Map are registered but unreachable by a player (only a QA test opens Map).

title: Hemi Bro wallet check: nonce/sign/verify round trip
what it tracks: One-at-a-time wallet verification: idle, pending (wallet prompt and chain read), ok, error, with a 90 s timeout.
top concern: A timed-out attempt's late signature is sent anyway and its refusal settles the next attempt; answers carry no attempt id.

title: The game socket's lifecycle: connect, open, reconnect, stop, tear down
what it tracks: One closure `ws` shared by every socket; a 15-value status shadow; reconnect roads that do and don't detach.
top concern: Undetached orphan sockets (Retry now, lockout timer, cleanup) later reconnect over the live one; the tab then reads 'superseded' while joined, watchdog off.

title: Join refusals: a message records why, the following close acts on it
what it tracks: Eleven refusal holders set by messages and consumed by onclose in a fixed priority order, also keyed by close code.
top concern: Server closes 4010 for both a linger and a thrown join; the client reads every 4010 as linger: wrong screen, fixed 5 s retry forever.

title: Server-ready gate and the connect veil
what it tracks: Whether the world may be shown: waiting, ready, not-ready (caps), lost; veil after a grace timer; _netHold freezes movement.
top concern: A drop while the loading screen is up skips the veil and never re-arms it; the world shows frozen, unexplained, for the outage.

title: Dead-pipe and stalled-connect watchdog, strikes held for the rejoin
what it tracks: 1 s heartbeat judging silence, unanswered settled sends, stuck connects and page freezes; replays one unanswered strike after a rejoin.
top concern: The first connect's lobby fetch has no timeout and no socket exists meanwhile, so nothing retries while the loading screen says we keep trying.

title: Coming back to the tab: resume / resync / graphics-probe ladder
what it tracks: visibilitychange, pageshow and the heartbeat's thaw all run one recovery: reload, reconnect, force rejoin, renderer rebuild.
top concern: Its 'may I reconnect?' exclusion is only superseded/idle, so a tab return rejoins origin, device, key, frozen and fatal-rejected tabs.

title: This device's identity: active Login Key, player id, stash and regen
what it tracks: Which character the origin boots and joins as: bt_passphrase, its id, the _prev stash, bt_key_ids, bt_device, the auth regen.
top concern: The join pairs the tab's in-memory id with the shared stored key; after another tab switches character, a reconnect gets 'auth' and mints new identities.

title: Login-key rotation: key_new, the old key kept, confirm or fall back
what it tracks: Eight-word keys handed to a phone; old key kept until a new-key join gets in; door ask and fallback once.
top concern: Each origin is its own device, so each origin playing an old key gets its own new key; the mirror shows duplicate rows.

title: The device's character roster and its cross-origin cookie mirror
what it tracks: Rows of Login Keys with provisional/looked/look flags, merged across localStorage, a shared cookie with tombstones, and bt_key_ids.
top concern: A remote tombstone deletes the origin's active row; its 30 s heartbeat re-adds it and strips the tombstone, undoing deletes and resurrecting rotated-out keys.

title: Waiting rooms: the world-is-full queue and the linger countdown
what it tracks: Two DOM waiting screens retrying on their own cadence through the shared reconnect timer until a state_sync admits the player.
top concern: 'Retry now' calls connect() without checking a socket already in its handshake, orphaning it.

title: Idle logout and 'I'm back' on the first touch
what it tracks: Two-state latch: logged out with armed listeners and a banner, back on any touch or the next ready state_sync.
top concern: A fallback-timer harvest strike after the logout can bring an abandoned tab back once by itself.

title: The account check gate (Turnstile before a character is made)
what it tracks: verify refusal -> widget -> spend-once token -> next join; retry button and attempts counter.
top concern: A tab return re-joins token-less, is refused, and shows the 'didn't go through' copy though nothing was tried.

title: The quiet phone's outbox: one frame per turn, riders with deadlines
what it tracks: Per-socket outbox and riders gated on this socket's caps; reset each open; due riders go alone or drop.

title: Input batching and move pacing
what it tracks: Latest-move holder and event buffer drained every 33 ms, with seen/solo/quiet/diet/path rate rules per batch.
top concern: A move or event buffered as the socket closed is sent after the next join, which the worker drops before session.id.

title: Caps negotiation and the client's deploy-order gates
what it tracks: S._serverCaps and ~30 module flags re-derived each state_sync, edited live by client_off and move_path.
top concern: Module-level flags hide which worker a number was computed for; between a reconnect's open and state_sync they describe the previous worker.

title: Other players' presence: listed, parked, near, ghost, gone, and the count
what it tracks: Peers made by six messages, removed by four, parked by presence v2, swept after 10 s; count has eight writers.
top concern: The online count uses four formulas; a leave for a never-held id decrements anyway, drifting below the map until a keys-based write.

title: Server-authority mode flags and zone snapshots (v1 trio and v2 zone_state)
what it tracks: _serverMonsters/_serverGatherNodes/_serverLoot flip legacy client paths on and off at state_sync and zone snapshots.
top concern: state_sync replaces monsters without the stale-zone check its zone applier has; a rejoin that doesn't hold movement can land the old zone's list.

title: Per-tick monster mirror: alive/dead/respawn edges and timed phases
what it tracks: Server monster deltas turned into edges and timers on the client's copies: death, respawn, stun, swell, burrow, aggro.
top concern: The tick's death edge pushes a client-rolled loot pile ungated by _serverLoot; slime-boss pops leave phantom piles credited locally.

title: Adopting the worker's player_state over the client's prediction
what it tracks: About 40 fields each adopted by its own rule: present-gated, absent-off, upward-only, latched, or applied last.
top concern: After the player cycles slots once, the server's activeSlot is ignored all session, though the worker itself resets it to melee on an unequip.

title: Worn vs in-the-bag gear: rescue, quest stash, drops, shield adoption
what it tracks: Worker owns worn slots, client its bag; each echo bags a displaced piece once unless an NML loss is recent.
top concern: A lost nml_loss turns a confiscation into a rescue: phantom pieces in the bag that the server refuses on re-offer.

title: The player's own death and respawn (client side)
what it tracks: _dying set by player_died, cleared by one shared respawn routine from the message or the stuck-dead watchdog.

title: Picking up a ground pile: asked, refused, credited, despawning
what it tracks: Per-pile pending flags with watchdogs, three refusal buckets and a fast-retry budget; credit despawns after 500 ms.
top concern: Death piles use the worker's wall-clock windows; a phone clock running ahead asks early, gets 'not-recipient', and drops the bag for good.

title: Other players' per-tick activity edges
what it tracks: Harvest, sprint, board, pose, skull, pet, armour grade and badge edges from each tick entry; slim entries handled deliberately.

title: The worker's refusal of an ability: cooldowns and the swing given back
what it tracks: Cooldown-until, swing-suppression-until and whirlwind windup corrected to the worker's answer; prediction only.

title: The per-session HTTP token for economy POSTs
what it tracks: Token minted per join, rotated on every rejoin, held by the client until the next state_sync.
top concern: A POST between a rejoin's open and its state_sync carries the old token and is refused (fails closed).

title: Onboarding seen flags carried across origins on cookies
what it tracks: Monotone once-per-browser flags (welcome, coach lessons, skip) in localStorage and a shared-domain cookie, read as either.

title: Crash-report upload debounce
what it tracks: When the localStorage crash ring is uploaded: slow and fast timers plus a dedupe on the ring's length.
top concern: Once the 16-entry ring is full its length never changes, so after the boot upload no later crash in that page is sent.

title: Page alive mark and killed-page detection
what it tracks: A 5 s alive mark per page, removed on pagehide; the next page pings and reports pages that died open.
top concern: One shared key: with two tabs open the other tab overwrites the mark, so a killed tab usually goes unreported.

title: WebGL context-loss escalation
what it tracks: A context loss stamps __btGlLostAt and arms a 2.5 s rebuild through BroTown's debounced rebuild door.

title: Debug bus and overlay
what it tracks: Debug console enabled and visible flags, permanent console and socket hooks, socket status, activation gesture.
top concern: ?debug=1 without ?dev=1 turns full socket and console capture on with no overlay mounted to show or close it.

title: Perf diagnostics (zone stats, spike log, HUD)
what it tracks: Per-zone frame-time epochs, a 500 ms spike-log throttle, global timer hooks and the perf HUD interval.

title: Gather-node snapshot self-heal
what it tracks: Stashes a node snapshot that raced the zone flip; re-sends the move up to four times for an empty zone.
top concern: A stash for an unentered zone lingers; the reclaim re-sends moves the worker never answers with a snapshot.

title: A peer's look across join and relay roads
what it tracks: One rename table maps wire cosmetic keys onto peers: snapshots in full, the 2 s track relay as deltas.
top concern: A pattern or drawing cleared mid-session never clears on peers; documented, and unreachable in the world today.

title: A ground-loot pile on this phone
what it tracks: Local copies of worker piles: dropped, claimed, despawned, expired, with owner-only windows re-based on arrival.

title: Other players' campfires and chop targets
what it tracks: Relayed peer campfires with capped fuses, extended while they cook, and a peer's chop tree; cleared per zone.

title: A dungeon run on this phone
what it tracks: Opening, inside, waves, boss, 30 s clear and leaving, across about fifteen S fields and a synthetic zone.
top concern: Three hand-written exits reset different subsets; the Workshop's skip the lock clear, zone fx, art release and delayed zone drop.

title: A monster's telegraph and visual phases
what it tracks: Wind-up, swell, burrow, throw, enrage, transform and split stamps per monster, from four families of writers.
top concern: _burstUntil is a truthy flag, not a clock: a missed execute leaves a slime swollen and untouchable, into its next life.

title: A monster's life on this phone
what it tracks: Alive, dead, respawned mirror of a server monster; kill event and tick both flip it; resets by hand.
top concern: The respawn reset omits the newer moment fields; only the swell sticks (see N2-11).

title: Another player's action stand-ins
what it tracks: Timed stamps for a peer's swing, bash, whirlwind, bow, cast, roll and jump, plus a boolean raised shield.
top concern: A peer's shield is lowered only by a relay that is dropped while they are in another zone, so it can stay up forever.

title: A monster's blow on me, as this phone shows it
what it tracks: The display verdict per monster_attack: ghost filters, worker block, local fallback block, dodge, death window, defense XP.
top concern: The fallback block re-judges blows the worker landed while the phone's shield is up: number hidden, HP still drops, defense trained.

title: Another player's corpse
what it tracks: _isDead set by a peer's death relay, cleared by their respawn relay or the renderer's moved-away self-heal.

title: Clan invite and clan war on the phone
what it tracks: Pending clan invite, the clan data echo and the phone's war record with scores and a 10 s end timer.
top concern: Clans are parties now; the legacy self-score and self-pay paths would mint coins against a worker without caps.clans.

title: A blow between two players and its bookkeeping
what it tracks: pvp_hit drawn on both sides, a 5 s server-resolved stamp, the defender's pvp_confirmed relay, the parry stagger.
top concern: The attacker's KILL! and kill count come only from the defender's relayed pvp_confirmed, though pvp_hit carries the worker's died.

title: A duel on this phone
what it tracks: Challenge card, optimistic accept, in-duel state and lock, arena match, ended; mirrors the worker's duel machine.
top concern: Accept enters the duel before the worker answers; a stale or busy challenge is dropped silently, leaving the phone in a duel.

title: Threat skulls from the threat handshake
what it tracks: Red and white threat skulls on me and on peers from the pvp_threat handshake, with consent windows.
top concern: Dormant; reviving it gives the skull slots two writers (No man's land nulls them) and a plain-object id map.

title: The two-sided trade window
what it tracks: One window slot driven by worker snapshots: incoming card, waiting invite, open, done receipt, failed, cancelled.
top concern: A cancel names no invite, so an old invite's expiry or decline wipes a newer card or the player's own waiting drawer.

title: The old one-sided trade relay
what it tracks: trade_offer card, trade_accept completion, trade_reject, and a local mint for an unsettled accept.
top concern: The unsettled branch credits the giver what they gave; reachable only against a pre-v2.3.1119 worker.

title: The party invite card and the roster
what it tracks: Invite stub cleared by a mirrored 60 s timer with an identity check; roster from worker snapshots.
top concern: PARTY_INVITE_TTL_MS hand-mirrors PARTY.INVITE_TTL with no mirror-audit pin.

title: Mail arriving: daily toast wait and gear catch-up
what it tracks: A bounded 90 s wait to show the daily reward toast; returned gear adopted into the local stash.

title: One-time move of old local friends to the server
what it tracks: bt_friendsMigrated flag, set after sending up to 25 friend requests for legacy local follows.
top concern: Follows past the 25th are dropped silently; one shot per device.

title: Hazard markers and effect queues
what it tracks: Telegraph and impact rings, fire trail, shockwaves and blasts as timed, capped queues drained by renderers.
top concern: Telegraph rings carry no zone and the worker's unclamped duration, so one can briefly outlive a zone change.

title: The room picture behind a building's window
what it tracks: Room background image lifecycle: loading, ready (keeper drawn), failed (box removed); remounted per room id.

title: The Saloon's alliance part (alliance, war, rename wait, board)
what it tracks: Alliance status, war, rename and war waits, and the alliance board, drawn from party_state.ally and allyBus.
top concern: Board shows 'Asking...' forever when the worker refuses or rate-limits alliance_board; nothing re-asks until the board is reopened.

title: The Bank vault window (one move in flight)
what it tracks: Vault view loading/open/closed/failed, a 4 s pending move keyed by opId, retry of a failed read.
top concern: S._bank is never cleared on reconnect or character switch; a reopened window briefly draws the old vault.

title: The Cookhouse's cook and eat (client prediction)
what it tracks: Cook/eat taps predict ingredients, dish, XP, level-up, quest flag and old-worker buff timers before the worker answers.
top concern: Client counts ingredients by k.includes(type), worker by exact key: a predicted cook and level-up celebration the worker then takes back.

title: The Gambling Den's free daily spin
what it tracks: Wheel phases idle/waiting/landing over the worker's stored pot (spin, double or nothing, collect, day rollover).
top concern: After 8 s with no answer the panel says 'Nothing was spent', though a slow or lost answer may have spent or lost the pot.

title: The Enchanter's three gem sockets
what it tracks: Weapon and shield gems asked with a 4 s pending gate; the amulet gem predicted locally with no gate.
top concern: Double tap on an amulet gem burns two gems (second replaces first); its refusals are silent, so the prediction sticks on v2.

title: The General Store's order book (place and cancel over HTTP)
what it tracks: Buy/sell/my-orders form, stash-index sell escrow, resting orders, cancel refunds, and an order-book cache.
top concern: No in-flight guard or opId: a second Place Sell tap escrows the next weapon at the same stash index under the first one's kind.

title: The Feed & Seed shop and order board (farmBus)
what it tracks: Farm view and order board from the worker; one pending request with 4 s / 12 s timeouts; midnight re-ask.
top concern: A late answer to a timed-out request clears the newer pending request; farmBus.reset() is never called.

title: The trip onto your farm (three copies of one zone entry)
what it tracks: Warp to farm_home: zone, map, position, per-zone arrays reset, farm art hold, return point remembered.
top concern: Land Office copy calls startZoneAmbient('town') after the farm hold asked for farm music, so that trip plays BroTown's village track.

title: The legacy browser-only farm plots
what it tracks: Plots planted and harvested on the phone by plantedAt+growTime stamps, only for workers without caps.farm.
top concern: Client-only farm the echo undoes; kept as a rule-19 fallback that every live worker bypasses.

title: The Gambling Den's gold wager and weekly jackpot
what it tracks: Chosen wager chip, worker-rolled bet with 2 s cooldown, 3 s result banner; jackpot pool and tickets.
top concern: Legacy local roll and local pool remain for workers without caps.gamble / caps.jackpot.

title: The Gem Works' first tab: crack/combine and the one-gem cut fallback
what it tracks: Shard crack and raw-gem combine asks with a 4 s pending gate; legacy one-gem cut when caps.shardcrack is off.
top concern: Kill-switch fallback counts only the retired gem pouch, emptied into the bag at every join: 'No raw gems yet' over a full bag.

title: The Gladiator Arena window (queue, fight card, the real stake)
what it tracks: Arena status polled from render, queue/fight/eliminated cards, and an append-only optimistic bet list.
top concern: A refused stake still reads 'Bet placed'; bets keyed by round only, so an old tournament's bet hides later tournaments' forms.

title: The Blacksmith's bench (signature watch, salvage two-tap arm)
what it tracks: One ask at a time; success inferred when a field signature changes within 3.5 s; smith work pose timer.
top concern: An answer slower than 3.5 s is announced 'Could not forge' with the fail sound, and the later success is never said.

title: The Woodworker's bench (copied watch, Traps and Hardened receipt counters)
what it tracks: Bow/staff craft and harden via P1-14's copied watch; trap and hardened-wood makes wait on receipt counters.
top concern: Same 3.5 s false failure as the Blacksmith; a refused make_traps never bumps its counter, holding the buttons 3.5 s.

title: The Auction House shelf
what it tracks: Shelf/yours tabs, category, one busy flag over buy, bid, accept and take-down; shelves re-read after answers.
top concern: Browse answers applied in arrival order; a fast category switch can show an older category's rows briefly.

title: The Auction House chat and offers (storeChatBus)
what it tracks: One listing's threads, offers and errors open at a time, plus per-listing unread counts.
top concern: Closing the building window leaves storeChatBus.open true: reopening shows the old chat, and that listing's new lines raise no dot.

title: The Town Board (grid, page, nav heading, pins)
what it tracks: Board grid vs a tile's page, the observed nav heading, and red/blue pin toggles stored per character.

title: Which building window is open (buildingPanel) and the halls that hand it on
what it tracks: One nullable panel id opened at doors or keepers, closed by ✕, scrim, Esc, hall rows and farm trips.
top concern: Panel buses and S fields outlive the window (store chat, market refresh key), read by the next opening as their own.

title: The two-sided trade window's one client slot (trade2) against the server's session machine
what it tracks: Invite, waiting, open, ready, review, accepted, done-watch, receipt, failed: one client slot mirroring trade2.js invites and sessions.
top concern: After a deploy or a seen drop the window survives as a phantom no button can close, hijacking bag taps and hiding chat until reload.

title: The trade window's local edit state (staging mirror, gold sign, leave ask, big-gold ack, offer-changed notice, bag hand-off)
what it tracks: Client-only phases beside the server snapshot: staged offer mirror, gold add/subtract, leave strip, big-gold ack, offer-changed notice.
top concern: The offer-changed notice watches confirm flags, but two-stage edits reset ready flags, so a last-second swap after you readied shows no warning.

title: The trade receipt's beats (both piles, fold, toss to the bag, auto-close)
what it tracks: Timed receipt: both piles, fold at 1.1 s, clones fly to the bag at 1.4 s, closed at 4.2 s.
top concern: A weapon-only or pet-only trade always waits the full 1.5 s done-watch fallback before the receipt shows.

title: The legacy one-way gift trade (TradePanel offer, IncomingTradePanel accept/decline)
what it tracks: Gift offer composed, relayed and held 2 min server-side, accepted or declined on an incoming card; only without caps.trade2.
top concern: trade_offer skips the v2.3.3526 block filter, so a blocked player on an old or modified page can still raise the Incoming Trade card.

title: The duel challenge card and the accepter's optimistic duel flag
what it tracks: Challenge card, accept/decline, the accepter's S._inDuel and lock, server challenge TTL and duel record, duel_end.
top concern: Accepting an expired (2 min) or refused challenge sets S._inDuel forever: no duel_end comes, so diet, No man's land asks and taps stay wrong.

title: The kill-threat card (Ignore / Call Guards) and its countdown
what it tracks: Threat card with a countdown, responded flag, skull marks; dormant while OPEN_PVP is false.
top concern: An answered threat is hidden, not cleared, so _uiBusy stays true for the session (no quest dialogue, no tutorial banner) once PvP returns.

title: The party slot: invite card, roster strip, chip fold and two-tap leave/kick
what it tracks: Party invite stub with identity-checked TTL, server roster renderer cleared on state_sync, folded chip and two-tap arms.
top concern: The state_sync clear also drops an invite card the server still holds up to 60 s; a newer invite replaces an older one unannounced.

title: Legacy clans: invite card, membership cache, logo editor and the client-clocked clan war
what it tracks: Clan create/join/leave cache, invite card, logo painting and a war each phone clocks itself; live only with clanparty off.
top concern: Each war member's phone ends the war on its own clock and picks a winner from its own relayed score copy.

title: The life-skill guild quest ladder (which rung you are on)
what it tracks: Per-skill ladder rung: the panel's device-local _guildProgress versus the server's guild_claims count, met only on a paid turn-in.
top concern: On a second device the panel restarts at rung 0 and offers Claim for rungs already paid; the server refuses naming another rung, repeatedly.

title: The computer's chat composer (closed / composing, with a kept draft)
what it tracks: C opens the composer; Enter sends and closes, Send stays open, Esc keeps the draft, the X clears it.
top concern: chatInputValRef is described as the canvas loop's mirror but nothing reads it any more.

title: The legacy feedback window's fetch-per-filter and vote toggle
what it tracks: Render-time fetch keyed by S._fbLastFilter, vote toggles, submit; only behind the hidden MenuBar.
top concern: Votes are toggles keyed by a client-named playerId with no session check; a double-tap un-votes. Shared with the live dashboard page.

title: The legacy leaderboard window's fetch-per-tab cache
what it tracks: Render-time fetch per tab into S._lbServerData with a peers fallback; only behind the hidden MenuBar.
top concern: A late answer for the previous tab overwrites the data under the current tab and is sorted by its key.

title: The quest giver's dialogue flow over the predicted quest record
what it tracks: Talk, offer or claim, Rewards claimed, next quest; the phone predicts accept and turn-in payouts before the worker answers.
top concern: Turn-in refusals for unmet objective, non-active quest or missing XP skill send no echo, so the predicted payout and next quest stand uncorrected.

title: NpcDialogue's line pager
what it tracks: Index over authored speech chunks, reset when the text changes, optional locked backdrop and action button.
top concern: The reset runs in an effect, so a new shorter speech can render one frame on the old index with last=true.

title: The quest banner: one slot, a 3-deep queue, per-kind hold times
what it tracks: QUEST ACCEPTED/COMPLETE/REWARD/WELCOME banner; player-caused preempt, system notices queue, waits behind loading screens.

title: The achievement banner's moments queue
what it tracks: Big achievements queued (max 6, dropped after 120 s), each shown 3.2 s once the world and icon are ready.

title: The stale-build watch and its New version available banner
what it tracks: Polls version.json; on a mismatch stops, reloads on pre-game screens, else shows a dismissible banner.
top concern: Once dismissed the watch is already stopped, so a later deploy in the same session is never announced (deliberate).

title: The player card's own sub-states (card / Inspect card, report row, async portrait)
what it tracks: Panel-local card/profile toggle, report reason row, generated portrait with an alive guard; reset by unmount.
top concern: reportSent is per mount, so reopening the card offers Report again (deliberate; the worker limits).

title: Friend and block relationships: a stale React copy the live player card reads and writes back
what it tracks: friendsList/blockedList seeded once from localStorage; dashboard and server friendships change underneath; the card shows and rewrites the stale copy.
top concern: Block P on the dashboard, then block Q on a player card: the card writes its old copy plus Q, silently unblocking P's requests.

title: Diego's shop drawer: selection, debounced quote, busy guard, list re-asks and the rejoin reset
what it tracks: Select, quote (140 ms debounce), busy, settle; bag key list re-asked every 700 ms; reset on rejoin.
top concern: Anyone's sale broadcast clears busy, and the button's total is never re-quoted when his pile moves, though settlement takes no expected price.

title: Touch-control press feedback and the cooldown-ended flash
what it tracks: data-pressed written outside React on every control, plus a per-button {was, at} edge detector for the ready flash.
top concern: RideButton, the one control drawn on computers, has no onMouseLeave: a press released elsewhere leaves it pressed and its mouse latch armed.

title: Whirlwind and Shield Bash buttons
what it tracks: Hidden, cooling, cannot-cast or ready: a 200 ms view of abilityStatus, re-read on every shield edge.

title: Block button: down, UP, cooling
what it tracks: The Block button draws the phone's _shieldUp and a 2 s stamina cooldown face.
top concern: The worker's 3 s guard break never reaches the phone, so the button stays lit UP; its cooldown face's one writer is switched off.

title: Jump button and the html[data-jump-clear] prompt switch
what it tracks: Ground/air/hidden on an 80 ms key poll, a 700 ms ghost-mouse window, and a page attribute set per commit.
top concern: Cleanup removes data-jump-clear but leaves three custom properties on <html>; harmless, every reader is scoped under the attribute.

title: Sprint button tap detector
what it tracks: Turns a real tap (14 px, 600 ms) into toggleSprint and shows off/on/running/tired from S._sprint.
top concern: A second finger on the button overwrites the pending touch so neither lift toggles; rare, harmless.

title: Special button: normal, cooling, no mana, queued AIM
what it tracks: Special's cooldown (_lastSwipe), mana and the bow's queued request (_bowSpecialQueued) drawn as one button face.
top concern: A bow special pressed while cooling queues and lights AIM; when the line lands the cooldown refuses silently, losing the special and that arrow.

title: TRAP button: ready, setting, armed, grey
what it tracks: A keyed 120 ms view of S._trap pending/mark; arm asks the worker, which decides and refreshes one mark.
top concern: Dead branch: the grey 'No box traps' row can never show because the view returns null first.

title: Skateboard button: off, asking, on, hidden
what it tracks: Ride toggle button over S._ride, hidden whenever a fight is near or you leave the safe ground.
top concern: Riding with a monster locked (or shield-live) hides the button while rideCheck keeps you on the board: a rider loses the only touch off-switch.

title: Quick-eat button
what it tracks: Shown with food and missing HP; a press posts the key to eatBus; the one-bite wait drawn as an arc.

title: Weapon pill: in hand, tap to swap, refusal shake, html[data-wpill-shown]
what it tracks: A keyed view of R.activeSlot and owned slots, a tap detector calling BroTown's one cycler, and a page attribute.
top concern: Five copies of the touch-echo window (800 ms here, 700 elsewhere); every pill tap also latches _userCycledSlot for the session.

title: Keyboard controls shown or hidden
what it tracks: bt_kb_hints_off: one writer (BroTown), three readers (React state, DeskKeysList, deskKeysW) of localStorage.
top concern: With storage refused the state flips but the desk-wide column and world width read storage, so the column never folds.

title: The two discs' DOM under BroTown's per-frame stamps
what it tracks: Render-only: initial opacity/pointerEvents/data-show that BroTown's resolver overwrites every frame.

title: Legacy toolbar: one window at a time and the old logout
what it tracks: display:none toolbar toggling the show* window flags and an old multi-RPC logout chain.
top concern: Its dead logout removes bt_passphrase, today's Login Key, the opposite of the live logout that keeps it.

title: Legacy modals: old Inventory, Skills, Stats, Info, Encyclopedia
what it tracks: Open/close flags reachable only by QA's _uiPanels, with local eat/equip/sell, stat locks and the Bro verify row.
top concern: InfoPanel is the only caller of verifyBro and nothing opens it, so the Hemi Bro wallet check is unreachable for players.

title: Furniture Workshop: crafting paid on the phone alone
what it tracks: Live farm-house window that takes coins and wood, grants XP and records furniture only in S.rpg and bt_rpg.
top concern: Craft sends nothing: client-only economy; v2 deltas never correct the lowered coins until the worker's coins change; _furniture lives on one device.

title: Old Pet House window (deploy-order fallback)
what it tracks: Active pet toggled locally in lifeSkills.pets; opens only when caps.petbook is not advertised.
top concern: If shown, the active pet is a phone-only choice kept in bt_rpg, the reason its own header retired Evolve and Enchant.

title: Ace's coin flip dialog
what it tracks: Open, staking, pending with a 6 s silent-refusal timeout, settled, closed; results carry no request id.
top concern: A reply slower than 6 s reads as a refusal and frees a second stake; a result after closing returns as next visit's stale verdict.

title: Emote picker and its pointerdown dismiss layer
what it tracks: Closed/open on Moves or Emoji (remembered in bt_emote_tab), closed by a pointerdown anywhere on a world-wide layer.
top concern: Closing on pointerdown lets the tap's click land on what lay underneath: a weapon-pill well swaps, TRAP arms, the canvas locks a monster.

title: Login door: checking, buttons, picker, device-full card
what it tracks: Logged-out page: checking, the two doors, the character list, and the full-device card.
top concern: The full-device card's scrim closes on pointerdown, so its tap can fall through onto Continue or Create beneath.

title: NEW MONSTER card
what it tracks: One {kind, at} codex announcement shown 3 s, its clock pushed forward while a loading screen is up.
top concern: A UI poll mutates the announcement's clock; held forever only if the loading screen itself never clears.

title: A new pet's card
what it tracks: S._trap.card raised when the snap animation ends; a draft name kept per card; Done or a sent name closes it.

title: Fish weigh-in card
what it tracks: Weighing, answered, closed after 9 s, ✕ or Records; module-level card re-armed per answer.
top concern: A late fish_weight reopens a card the player had already closed, since the answer ignores st.pending.

title: Sound studio's music preview
what it tracks: Off / playing(key) preview on its own <audio>, ducking the game's music bus and holding the land-music watch off.
top concern: The duck is a one-shot gain write; a bus rebuilt after an iOS context loss brings zone music back under the preview.

title: Sound studio's way in (closed, opening, open)
what it tracks: Module host/root/promise trio lazily mounting the studio once; ?sounds polls until the world is up.
top concern: A close during the lazy import is ignored and the studio mounts anyway (test-only route).

title: Design gallery scrim latch and Escape
what it tracks: Gallery over the paint panel: press-began-on-scrim latch, category filter, capture-phase Escape leaving the editor intact.

title: Test panel admin call lifecycle
what it tracks: Single busy flag, message line and 12 s abort for every admin HTTP call; quiet background refresh touches neither.
top concern: busy is a boolean, not a count: chained calls leave microtask gaps where buttons re-enable and a second action can overlap.

title: Test panel's copy of server-held toggles
what it tracks: Panel snapshot of god mode, test mode and spar state; each toggle sends an absolute value derived from it.
top concern: The snapshot never ticks and replies are unordered, so a stale snapshot (expired god mode, late quiet refresh) sends the wrong direction once.

title: Message diet modes and memory savers as live-flag chains
what it tracks: Message-diet modes and memory savers set as chains of live-flag writes with no rollback.
top concern: A chain failing half-way leaves an unpicked mode live: from kill, 'Only ?diet=1' can end with the diet on for every phone.

title: Test panel two-tap arms and once-shown key
what it tracks: Armed latches for Freeze, Forget devices and New key, disarmed by editing the code or acting; new key shown once.
top concern: Arms never expire and Forget/New key can both be armed; both name the target, so no wrong-target case found.

title: Test panel zone warp (S._devWarp)
what it tracks: S._devWarp destination walked through the old map's hub doors leg by leg by driveDevWarp.
top concern: Retired-map only; the client writes P.x/P.y; the empty Zones section still renders in the world.

title: Shared ink/brush tool store
