what it tracks: Module ink/brush pair shared by the creator's inline palette and the editor, mirrored by seed and write-back effects.

title: Creator's look: store and React mirrors, species rules, Randomize, Reset
what it tracks: Trait picks written to sprite stores and React mirrors by tabs, species rules, Randomize's flair interval and Reset.
top concern: Randomize's 110 ms flair interval is never cancelled: Reset inside 330 ms is overwritten; ENTER snapshots a mid-flair look into bt_resume.

title: Name entry and the Enter BroTown gate
what it tracks: Press latch plus live block reason gating Enter BroTown; iOS keyboard pad from visualViewport.
top concern: The name field's Enter checks length only, so a pinch-zoomed phone gets joinTown's alert instead of the inline reason.

title: Creator preview drag-to-rotate vs tap-to-zoom
what it tracks: Pointer machine on the creator preview: 26 px drag steps the facing, a still tap toggles zoom, cue earned once.
top concern: No pointerId tracking: a second finger resets the drag and can toggle the zoom.

title: Creator's ink card: which editor is open
what it tracks: Which drawing editor is open (showPaint) and the inkRev counter that re-memoises the creator's look.
top concern: PlayerPaint has no key; a keyboard-reached card behind the scrim swaps target without remount, writing one garment's pattern onto another.

title: Paint editor: canvas being inked, its doc and undo history
what it tracks: Which of nine canvases is inked (mode, side, finger) plus its op-list doc, per-canvas undo/redo and persist effect.
top concern: One value lives in five places updated at different moments; five recorded bugs (v2.3.1967 to v2.3.2431) were in this handshake.

title: Paint editor gesture and held piece
what it tracks: Stroke, shape drag, pick-up, move and resize gestures, and the held piece's pend record with Place and Cancel.
top concern: Cancel after a layer move unbanks nothing, so the next Undo resurrects the cancelled shape or colour.

title: WornPreview and BodyInk composite loops
what it tracks: rAF-coalesced character composites for the worn preview and the inkable body: idle, scheduled, baking, dirty.
top concern: A request made while an older effect's bake awaits images is never re-kicked; the preview stays one change behind.

title: BodyInk pointer machine (draw, pinch, pan, held grab, auto-fit)
what it tracks: Pointer map, pinch record and per-gesture locked canvas on the body surface, plus pan mode and auto-fit per region.
top concern: Three fingers start a new gesture fed by every pointer, and a stale pinch resumes on the remaining pair.

title: Character picker roster lookup loop
what it tracks: Sequential per-row account lookups filling roster names, levels and looks, restarted on every roster change.
top concern: The effect restarts after each answer while the old loop's next fetch is already sent: rows after the first are asked twice against 20/min.

title: Character picker options road (menu, typed confirm, remove/restart)
what it tracks: Menu then typed-yes confirm for removing or restarting a roster row; busy blocks every exit while the restart runs.

title: Character picker portraits
what it tracks: Per-row async face raster keyed on the look, discarded when the row unmounts or its look changes.

title: Dungeon Workshop pack store and saved dungeons
what it tracks: Dungeon pack purchases and five saved designs held only in the client's rpg copy and the bt_rpg cache.
top concern: Buy subtracts gold on the phone with no server message; the gold returns on the next coin update and the pack stays owned.

title: Dungeon Workshop launch: worker run vs legacy local arena
what it tracks: dungeon_start request to the worker's instance, with a legacy client-only arena when caps.dungeon is missing.
top concern: A cap-named 'dungeon: false' flag would send players into a client-only arena; the eleven run flags have two writers.

title: Sound studio view: tabs, filters, heard ticker
what it tracks: Tab and filter view state plus a 500 ms re-render ticker alive only on the heard and music tabs.

title: Editor op-list store (bt-artops)
what it tracks: Per-canvas op lists kept in bt-artops beside the art, flattened whenever they stop replaying to the stored drawing.
top concern: No shape number: a newer op kind read by an older client silently loses its shapes (pixels kept).

title: Trait picker 'more below' cues
what it tracks: Two derived scroll flags re-measured on scroll, tab and pick changes, and by one ResizeObserver.

title: Dungeon Workshop design being edited
what it tracks: In-memory Workshop design and tab; the waves slider shows a clamped value while the stored config keeps the larger one.
top concern: Default 3 waves shows as 2 below level 10 and fails validation, disabling Play with no visible cause.

title: Head-piece (trait) loader: per-facing load, give-up, later rounds, own-head watch
what it tracks: Per head piece and facing: asking, loaded, designed-missing, gave-up, later rounds, plus a watch that re-asks hidden pieces.
top concern: Watch starts a new three-try chain every 2.5 s beside one sleeping on its retry timer; rounds uncapped, unlike the spec.

title: Body placement data (body-anchors/body-tops): one promise, rounds after a failure
what it tracks: Deduped fetch promise for the body placement tables, with retries and a 20 s re-arm after a failed round.
top concern: Bare fetch without a timeout: a stalled request never settles, the promise is never re-armed, every head piece hidden for the page.

title: HUD bar art: load once, never asked again
what it tracks: One-shot latch loading the HP/node bar frame and fill textures every bar draws from.
top concern: A flaked bar-art load is swallowed and the latch never re-arms: monster, peer and node HP bars vanish until reload.

title: Masked-body bake worker and its one-job queue (rank, epoch, patience)
what it tracks: Worker lifecycle plus a serial rank-ordered bake queue; local misses open epochs and fall back inline after 1 s.
top concern: Only the local path has the hung-job patience; one job that never settles stalls peers, prewarm and look-armour bakes for the session.

title: Masked-body frame cache: LRU, worn-set-last eviction, deferred destroy
what it tracks: Bounded LRU of armoured body frames; evicts other armour first; destroys evicted frames 30 s later.
top concern: Worker-cropped frames are not canvas witnesses; other witnesses still catch a tab wipe.

title: Peer armoured frames: hold the last frame, prewarm on a look change
what it tracks: Per peer display: hold the last masked frame while the worker bakes the next; queue their stand/jog prewarm.
top concern: Hold has no deadline: a peer's belt-pending jog bake is never cached, so their body freezes on one frame until belt sheets load.

title: Armour prewarm passes: intro, idle one-equip-away, equip-change re-prewarm
what it tracks: Debounce/running/again latch, supersede counter and owned-gear signature driving background armour bakes.
top concern: A never-settling bake leaves _equipPrewarmRunning true forever; prewarmProgress is dead state nothing reads.

title: Fishing head-and-rod overlay cache (armoured or shirted angler)
what it tracks: 64-entry LRU of per-frame canvas overlays lifting the head and rod above the shirt or plate while fishing.
top concern: Eviction skips Pixi's Cache entry (TRAPS 139); three anglers thrash the per-frame keys, leaking ~64 KB per frame change.

title: A hat's hair-mask loader (per facing, ten later rounds)
what it tracks: Per hat and facing: asking, loaded, failed, waiting, next round, up to ten rounds.
top concern: Bare Assets.load without a time limit: a stalled mask is never retried, hair drawn unclipped through the hat all page.

title: NFT face and mannequin textures: loaded every session, never drawn
what it tracks: One-shot latch loading test-1 NFT face sheets and naked stand sheets into slots nothing reads.
top concern: Ten 256x256 pictures (2.5 MB decoded) held for the session by a dormant Bro-NFT phase-4 loader.

title: Module overrides set around a figure's head-piece placement
what it tracks: _crownOverride, _folkHatDy256 and _qaHatDy256 change every _placeTrait while set around one figure's draw.
top concern: _crownOverride has no try/finally: a throw mid-placement leaves the knight crown on later heads until reset.

title: Hair clip target per figure (none, hat silhouette, hood)
what it tracks: Per frame: clip the hair to a clipping hat's mask, else a ready hood mask, else unclipped.

title: Gathering node HP bar: ghost trail, flash, call halo
what it tracks: One holder's ghost, drain and flash timers for the node bar; reset on hide, rebuilt on destroy.
top concern: One holder for all nodes: switching nodes without a hidden frame flashes a phantom hit.

title: Chat bubble lifetime gate (plate steps aside)
what it tracks: Per speaker a 5 s bubble window that hides the name plate while the bubble is drawn.
top concern: The 5000 ms is written separately in entityRenderer, effectsRenderer and stateCleanup; unpinned.

title: Plate and head icons loaded once (Bro badge, small icons, quest pins)
what it tracks: Held icon textures filled once on the loading screen and bound to plate and head sprites when present.
top concern: No time limit or later round: a failed load leaves badge, party badge, skull and talk bubble invisible all session.

title: Threat skull phase over a head (red, white consent window)
what it tracks: Pure time phase red then white then none over server-stamped threat times, with a per-display change cache.
top concern: S._threatMarks is a plain {} keyed by wire ids (CLAUDE.md rule); ids are server-issued, so hygiene only.

title: Local corpse hold guard (selfCorpseUp, 3.5 s)
what it tracks: Exported guard: dead while hp<=0 or within 3.5 s of _deathStart; stand-ins and gathering obey it.
top concern: Self plate hides on S._dying, stand-ins on selfCorpseUp; consistent today, unpinned.

title: Carried greatsword grip hole (inverse stencil on the fist)
what it tracks: One-bit _gripHoleOn latch on the weapon sprite with a clear that undoes mask side effects.

title: Attack stand-in clocks: swing 250/300 ms, bow draw-release-hold 110/360 ms
what it tracks: Swing and bow-shot phases read off one start stamp against constants exported from this file.
top concern: Arrow release latch hard-codes 110 in projectiles.js instead of BOW_RELEASE_MS; no mirror-audit line.

title: Overlay sprites made on first need (whirl glow, look-armour residue)
what it tracks: Lazily created child sprites that copy the body while shown and blank themselves when their texture goes.

title: The mana and stamina spend bars (show on spend, hold 1 s, fade by 2 s)
what it tracks: Local MP/stamina block bars: appear on a spend, hold 1 s, fade by 2 s, swept on death.

title: Your own HP band over your head (event-shown, heal-held, hard swap with your name plate)
what it tracks: Self HP bar revealed by HP change, held 2.5 s or while healing, plate hidden while it shows.
top concern: HEAL_STALL_MS 9000 must outlast the worker's 6 s regen gap with nothing pinning them; fade steps per frame, slow on slow phones.

title: A monster's death on screen (stamp, cut or splat, strip fallback, display kept until DONE)
what it tracks: Per-life death stamp on the monster, DEATH_NONE/LIVE/DONE decides display survival; reset by two respawn writers.
top concern: Displays destroyed mid-death skip clearMonsterDeath; zone-death state lingers in _live until the next roll prunes it.

title: A monster's arrival flourish (white silhouette that grows in over 620 ms)
what it tracks: Alive-edge detector stamps _spawnFxAt; white filter, alpha and scale grow in, removed only on the alive path.
top concern: A monster killed in its first ~410 ms keeps the white filter, low alpha and shrunken scale through its whole death.

title: The blue slime's death swell (and the giant slime's split swell): intangible while _burstUntil is set
what it tracks: Client copy of a slime's swell; ends only on the execute event; makes the slime intangible and swollen.
top concern: A rejoin after the slime exploded and respawned carries the swell onto the new life: drawn swollen, unhittable, untargetable on that phone.

title: The snowman's burrow on screen (dig, pile, emerge; self-clearing mirror of the worker's phase)
what it tracks: Event, tick and renderer self-clear keep a snowman's burrow phase and its client invulnerability flag.
top concern: A phone meeting the pile only via the tick arms 400 ms; renderer clears at 900 ms, tick re-arms: blinking mound and intangibility gaps.

title: A monster's wind-up throb (scale pulse that tightens until the strike)
what it tracks: Wind-up until-stamp from the wire drives a scale throb; renderer self-clears and stamps _tgSeen.

title: A monster's body strip: which animation plays and which way it faces
what it tracks: Three hand-written animation priority ladders (variant, slime, snowman) over hit/attack/transform stamps; two-sighting facing hysteresis.
top concern: Each new strip adds a rung by hand in three ladders that already disagree on interrupt order; opaque, no live bug found.

title: A monster's head band: HP bar in a fight, name plate at rest
what it tracks: One predicate (locked with intent or hit by you within 3 s) swaps a monster's plate for its HP bar.

title: A monster's head marks: the notice !, the stun ring and countdown, the status dots
what it tracks: Time-gated notice, stun and status marks on one Graphics with a clear-once dirty latch.
top concern: Stun stars compare the worker's epoch with the phone clock; cosmetic skew.

title: The Wheel's no-look-not-drawn gate (renderer half of the walk-in look loader)
what it tracks: Renderer destroys a Wheel monster's display while its look is not ready; loader frees unneeded looks.

title: Who gets drawn: far cull and crowd cap for monsters, players and their pets
what it tracks: Per-frame far cull and crowd cap hide displays; per-peer timers only advance while a peer is drawn.
top concern: Corpse self-heal and ask-icon expiry freeze while a peer is culled and resume with the new position as death spot.

title: Another player's corpse (death sprite until player_respawned, or until the corpse walks away)
what it tracks: Peer _isDead set and cleared by one-shot events; renderer also clears it after 1.5 s and 24 px of movement.
top concern: A peer culled while dead and missed respawn event is drawn as a corpse at the new place until they walk 24 px.

title: Another player's raised shield (block pose, held shield) from the sticky player_shield relay
what it tracks: Peer guard is a sticky boolean set only by the player_shield relay; drives block pose, held shield, hidden weapon.
top concern: Down edge dropped when the peer is in another zone, lost on rejoin, never repeated by tick: observers show a guard up forever or never.

title: Another player's body pose and stride
what it tracks: Peer copy of the self pose ladder from relayed and ticked fields, with moving hysteresis and stride phase.
top concern: Hand copy of the self ladder: peers lack pickup and smithing poses, so a peer smithing stands still; timed poses end in three files.

title: Another player's HP bar in a fight (8 s after a reported hit, swaps with their plate, band lifted off yours)
what it tracks: Peer HP bar shown 8 s after each pvp_hit, plate as complement, band eased clear of yours.

title: Marks over another player: the PvP threat skull and the no-man's-land duel-ask icon
what it tracks: Time-gated threat skull with cached phase; duel-ask icon created on demand, destroyed on expiry.
top concern: S._threatMarks may be a plain {} keyed by peer ids (house rule says null-prototype); ids are worker-issued.

title: Your own corpse (held 3.5 s or while HP is 0; the renderer seeds the stamp)
what it tracks: Self corpse = hp<=0 or within 3.5 s of _deathStart; seven writers in five files; renderer seeds the stamp.
top concern: Corpse path returns early, freezing every stand-in flag _updatePlayer publishes; each reader must re-ask selfCorpseUp.

title: Your own pose, facing and the stand-in hand-off
what it tracks: Nine-rung pose and eleven-rung facing ladders; publishes stand-in flags for effectsRenderer and the facing BroTown broadcasts.
top concern: Published flags refresh only inside their own branch and freeze on the corpse; readers hold by convention; renderer's facing goes on the wire.

title: The weapon in your hand (fist hole mask, eased hand position, hand cap and arm clones)
what it tracks: Inverse stencil fist-hole mask with an on/off latch and eased hand position keyed by facing, pose, type.

title: The stat scene's photo shoot (capturePoseFrames)
what it tracks: Swaps in a private player display and runs _updatePlayer on a fake state to photograph roll and jog frames.
top concern: Fake state keeps real _jump/_climb/_ride/_farmWork; module state (_lastWeaponSprite, bake epoch, head watch) not restored.

title: Your pet and other players' pets on screen
what it tracks: Local pet display (follow, fetch run, ward ring) and peer pets eased behind owners, gated on petshow cap.

title: Scenery props and foreground pieces (texture bound on first sight, dropped on zone change)
what it tracks: Per-prop sprite texture binding EMPTY to bound to EMPTY, dropping textures the zone change frees.

title: A townsperson's figure: live from their look near you, a photograph otherwise, nothing when far
what it tracks: Townsperson display built live near, destroyed far, photo fallback re-binds destroyed textures, marks lifted once.

title: A townsperson's quest mark (offer tag, waiting ?, ready check; else the talk bubble)
what it tracks: Quest giver mark computed per frame on the phone from the quest model; renderer caches badge per marker string.
top concern: Ready check is the phone's own predicate over its own bag; can disagree with what the worker accepts at hand-in.

title: The harvest stand-in hand-off (body put away while the gathering figure draws)
what it tracks: Self or peer body hidden only once the chop/cook/fire/farm stand-in exists; corpse paths re-show it.

title: The staff's crystal position handed to the cast effects (trusted for 250 ms)
what it tracks: Renderer stamps staff tip position and behind-ness each drawn frame; cast effects ignore tips older than 250 ms.

title: The resonance streak badge over your head
what it tracks: Badge shows the client-computed resonance streak count for 10 s after the last resonant combo.
top concern: Badge hard-codes 10000 instead of RESONANCE_STREAK_WINDOW_MS; the streak and its mana bonus are computed on the phone.

title: The effects renderer's own life: alive, then let go of, with async work still in flight
what it tracks: An EffectsRenderer's alive-to-destroyed life and every async bake, load or timer that could land after it.
top concern: None live; only _loadBowStrip's callback lacks the _destroyed check, harmlessly (Assets textures, no bake).

title: The gathering-pose registry: idle, loading, ready or failed, forgotten
what it tracks: Each gathering pose's idle/loading/ready/failed record in standIns.js, driven by _standInTriggers and the renderer's makers.
top concern: 'ready' counts the raw slices, so a skipped skin bake hides your body behind the artist-coloured lumberjack (by design).

title: Your own lumberjack, cook and fire-lighter: baked, re-baked on every look change, shared with peers in your colours
what it tracks: Your lumberjack, cook and fire-lighter strips and their colours key, re-baked on every look, drawing or greaves change.
top concern: A bake throwing on its second strip leaves mixed strips, the colours key null and the old strip never released.

title: Another player's gathering figure, baked in their colours inside one 16 MB allowance
what it tracks: Which figure a gathering peer is drawn from: yours, one baked in their colours, or none, within 16 MB.
top concern: entityRenderer's peek and the draw must reach the same branch each frame; the idle release hides in a try-wrapped draw's tail.

title: A drawn peer's drawings layer over their cook or fire-lighter
what it tracks: A drawn peer's tattoo layer over their cook or fire-lighter: baking, ready, evicted or idle-dropped, two per kind.
top concern: No load timeout and no failure clock: a hung image blocks the layer for good; a refused canvas re-bakes every frame.

title: Your sword and bow stand-in strips: loading, baked, a look marker, or refused and baked the old way
what it tracks: Your 21 sword/bow stand-in strips moving between loading, baked, look-palette marker and refused-fallback bake.
top concern: One crowd fight filling the palette atlas leaves strips as full bakes for the visit; only a look change clears _btNoLook.

title: Peers' swing and shot recolour bakes: kept while on a sprite this frame or the last, then least-recently-used out
what it tracks: The LRU of peers' recoloured swing and shot strips, protected by per-frame stamps from freeing a drawn source.
top concern: The trim skips the sprite walk; safe only because every remote draw sets its texture before showing the sprite.

title: A popup over a head: pushed, minted on first draw, climbing and fading, destroyed by whichever expirer sees it first
what it tracks: A damage number or message from push to mint to fade, expired by both the game loop and the renderer.
top concern: A zone change destroys the Texts but keeps the entries, so the renderer re-mints old-zone popups at old coordinates on the new map.

title: The damage numbers' glyph atlas: installed, warmed on one renderer and its pages emptied, re-installed for a rebuilt renderer, or dropped for the page
what it tracks: The damage digits' bitmap font: installed, pages emptied on one renderer's GPU, re-installed after a rebuild, or dropped.
top concern: Any single throw switches the page to classic Text for good; a rebuilt renderer never retries the install.

title: Another player's dodge roll: set by their broadcast, ended only by this renderer's particle pass
what it tracks: A peer's dodge/lunge/dash record and afterimages; started by player_dodge, ended only in this renderer's particle loop.
top concern: Undrawn peers keep a stale roll: one frame of dodge pose and no shield on reappearing; their snow prints read a stale walk flag.

title: Short-lived world effects the particle pass ages and reaps: hit sparks, death bursts, shock arcs, telegraph zones, impact rings
what it tracks: Transient effect lists (hit sparks, bursts, arcs, telegraph zones, impact rings) aged and reaped by the particle pass.
top concern: Telegraph zones and impact rings have no cap or zone-change clear; a hidden desktop tab grows them until the first frame back.

title: The full-screen flashes and the zone-change colour wipe
what it tracks: Full-screen flash stamps (block, level-up, death) and the zone-change colour wipe, drawn and nulled by two files.
top concern: S._zoneWipe is written as a number but read as {ts, duration}: never drawn, never cleared; S._damageFlash has no writer at all.

title: Projectile sprites: one per live projectile (bolt, special, slime ball) or index pools refilled each frame (arrows, dots)
what it tracks: Sprites for live projectiles (back-referenced, reaped by a live set) and index pools for arrows and hit dots.
top concern: Pools never shrink (up to 700 dot sprites); a goo ball freezes once when the monster-shot atlas becomes ready.

title: The bow's jet-stream streaks: fed while their arrow flies, lingering, then dead
what it tracks: Bow jet-stream streaks that outlive their arrows; switched off by JET_STREAM_ENABLED since v2.3.2448.

title: The local monster wind-up ring (m._telegraphUntil)
what it tracks: A monster's local wind-up window, written only by the client's local AI that never runs with server monsters.

title: The effects' own pictures that load late or per land: retried icons, crowns.json, the frost burst load-and-free, the pan's fish
what it tracks: Late or per-land effect textures (popup icons, crowns.json, arrow blast, frost burst, pan fish) and their retry rules.
top concern: Retry rules disagree: blast and icons give up for the page; a swallowed burst failure still marks the snowman look ready.

title: The combat marks over monsters: candidate carets, the lock chip's first-second flare, the melee reach ring's pick, the bow's sight line
what it tracks: Per-frame combat marks: candidate carets, the lock chip's one-second flare, the reach ring's pick, the bow's sight line.
top concern: The 'attacking' test is written four times with mixed clocks; the chip and the reach ring disagree about a 0-HP monster.

title: Chat bubble lifecycle (made, updated, faded, destroyed)
what it tracks: Per-speaker speech bubble: made on text, re-measured on change, faded at 4.5 s, destroyed when quiet.

title: Emote pop over the head
what it tracks: Emoji Text per player popping, settling, rising and fading over EMOTE_POP_MS, destroyed the frame it ends.

title: A ground loot pile's life on the phone
what it tracks: Pile landing, lying, rare call, last-call pulse, expiry and disposal; the renderer splices S.groundLoot itself.
top concern: Renderer removes monster piles at 30 s (phone clock vs worker ts); worker keeps and grants them until 60 s, groundLoot.js says 60 s/forever.

title: Ground decals: footprints and hit splatter fading by age
what it tracks: Footprint and splatter decals fading by age against TTLs that stateCleanup filters by; pools hide.

title: Snapped arrow pieces
what it tracks: Queue-fed arrow-snap pieces flying, landing flat, resting, fading; capped and wiped on zone change.

title: Marks on props: slashes, stuck arrows and burn marks
what it tracks: Prop marks with per-kind TTLs and caps, broken-object exit, zone wipe; your planted arrows reaped by tick.
top concern: Per-prop overlay containers are only hidden when empty, never destroyed inside a zone; the Wheel is one zone all session.

title: A gather node's drawn life (alive, broken, revived, see-through, promoted)
what it tracks: Node draw follows worker alive flag, one-shot break, orphan dispose, tree fade ease, layer promotion while worked.

title: One-shot effect queues (bursts, blasts, shockwaves, smoke, pops)
what it tracks: Game/wire queues drained into playing lists, stepped by age, destroyed at end; frost frames freed mid-play handled.

title: A vein breaking (crack, split, settle, fade)
what it tracks: Ore break once-flags cracked/popped/faded on the break's age, with a lateness bound for stalled frames.

title: The fire goblin's burning ground (inert, lit, guttering, out)
what it tracks: Fire patches restamped at receipt with remaining life and arm time: inert, lit, guttering, spliced.

title: Whirlwind wind-up ring, catch marks and vortex
what it tracks: Wind-up ring for you and peers, client copy of the worker's catch scan into S._whirlCatch, then the vortex.
top concern: Catch measured at drawn positions while the worker scans its own; an edge monster can be painted caught and missed.

title: The smith at work (anvil, fire and sparks)
what it tracks: Smithing FX container shown while S._smithing lasts, strike-frame edge for sparks and the hammer sound.

title: Elemental status looks on you and on peers
what it tracks: Thirteen *Until status stamps on you or a peer drawn as looks; peer pre-filter repeats the active-status test.
top concern: Peer pre-filter omits _wobbleUntil/_frozenUntil, so a peer's post-daze wobble is never drawn; clearElemStatuses has no caller at all.

title: Your fire-lighting figure
what it tracks: S._firemaking's 700 ms light drives a once-through strip at its spot, then the tick lights the campfire.

title: Other players' harvest stand-ins and their pool
what it tracks: Per-peer stand-in entry (code, start, drawn-last-frame, side) driven by relayed o._ex; reaped when the peer leaves.
top concern: Peer-left reap never destroys ent.gear legs/shirt/chest sprites; three hidden sprites per departed gatherer stay in gestureLayer all session.

title: Other players' sword swing, bow shot and block stand-ins
what it tracks: Peer attack poses from relayed swing/shot stamps; entityRenderer hides the body, this pass draws the stand-in.
top concern: Swings and shots have no readiness handshake: body hidden on the stamp, stand-in skipped if the bake returns null, peer invisible 300-360 ms.

title: Your sword and bow stand-ins and the flags traded with entityRenderer
what it tracks: Your swing, shot and block pose drawn from entityRenderer's flags; publishes _bowArtReady and the bow grip back.
top concern: _bowArtReady answers for the last shot's facing one frame late while a block can face anywhere; all facings preload today.

title: Gear strip and dressed-shirt textures (loading, ready, failed, dropped)
what it tracks: Per-key gear strip and dressed-shirt texture states with load guards, LRU, farm drop and rebuild release.
top concern: A strip whose one fetch fails is cached as [] forever; that armour or shirt vanishes from attack and gathering poses all session.

title: The farmer's moves, made on the farm and let go of on leaving
what it tracks: Farm strips, tools and garments made per generation behind the farm's loading screen, re-baked, freed on exit.
top concern: Leave and re-enter while tools load: the stale generation's Assets.unload destroys the texture the new generation just cut frames from.

title: The harvest's visuals and sounds, read off S._extraction
what it tracks: Waiting/ready harvest phases read in eight places: bar, label, chopper, cook, clink, splash, grease, SFX loops.
top concern: SFX loops stop only when this pass runs each frame; an earlier unwrapped pass throwing leaves sizzle or water playing. Linger code is dead.

title: Fish flying into the bag (catch flights)
what it tracks: Catch-flight arc animation still stepped each frame; nothing has pushed S._catchFlights since v2.3.1429.

title: The Wheel's dressing, made on first need and let go by an empty list
what it tracks: Wheel managers (fish, auras, doors, signposts, race flags, trap marks) made on demand, drained with an empty list.

title: Photographing the world's effects for the stat scene
what it tracks: Captures borrow stand-in sprites and window probes between frames and restore them in finally.

title: Owning a baked picture (owned, GPU only, waiting for first draw, let go)
what it tracks: Each bake registered so re-bakes, farm exit or rebuild release it after pointing sprites at Texture.EMPTY.

title: The renderer's own life: made (async), live, destroyed, rebuilt
what it tracks: Pixi renderer birth (qa delay, picture restores, app.init), live use, destroy, rebuild by canvas epoch; module-level handles.
top concern: A cleanup during a pending init destroys nothing; the stale init later assigns itself, leaking a WebGL context or drawing to a detached canvas.

title: The WebGL context: asked for, lost, restored, judged on a tab's return
what it tracks: Context loss/restore stamps, depth-buffer patch, no-stencil latch, and the tab-return keep-or-rebuild-ground decision.
top concern: createPixiApp's loss listener lacks crashTrap's isConnected test, so each rebuild teardown logs a synthetic gl-context-lost into the crash ring.

title: One frame's passes: the camera on whole device pixels, your place lent to the draw
what it tracks: update() shifts S.player by a sub-pixel for the world passes and restores it; throw-once latches; pool sweep clock.
top concern: One unwrapped silhouettes.clear() between shift and restore could leave the player shifted; practically unreachable.

title: A world that will not draw: the render-throw streak, the heal, the one rebuild
what it tracks: Counts consecutive throwing frames (app.render and update) and asks for one rebuild exactly at the 90th.
top concern: A 90th throw inside the 5 s rebuild window is dropped (a throw is not a loss) and never asked again; only the watchdog recovers.

title: The renderer's zone: which world-holders exist, cleared on every zone or map swap
what it tracks: onZoneChange observes zone/map identity and owns one-at-a-time Wheel objects, farm and arena holders plus clears.
top concern: Holders are made only on the zone-change edge; a same-zone map swap reruns the full entry clear.

title: The loading-screen gate: global pictures loaded, baked, uploaded
what it tracks: preloadPlayerAssets pipeline: wave 1, wave 2, mask bake, alt sets, GPU uploads, program warms; report and QA steps.
top concern: __btPreloadReport can never say rejected (groups are caught before allSettled), so QA 'fulfilled' checks are vacuous; no per-group timeout.

title: A zone's own art: loaded behind its loading screen, freed a beat after you leave
what it tracks: preloadZoneAssets/freeZoneAssets with a 400 ms deferred free against the destination named at scheduling time.
top concern: A death in the Wheel frees its art 400 ms out; the town stop returns after a 400 ms settle; order holds by one frame.

title: A zone banner's strip: cold, warming, held, let go
what it tracks: Per-theme decoded banner strip held in a Map with in-flight dedupe and a cache-only ready gate.
top concern: freeZoneBanner skips a theme still in flight; the warm then lands and holds the strip for a zone already left.

title: The DOM pictures warmed on the gate and held for the page
what it tracks: Seven warm-decode-hold modules (controls, cue, XP bar, quest art, level-up, stat demo, chest); only chest memoised.
top concern: Each rejoin without reload re-bakes the blue slime into new unrevoked blob URLs and holds ~2.4 MB more decoded strips.

title: The ground under a zone: which ground is live, and the map put off for today's town
what it tracks: TileRenderer picks one of six grounds per rebuild, with deferred town map, post-rebuild reloads, label pool and memos.
top concern: Zone-label Text pool is hidden, never destroyed or emptied (TRAPS §192); _forceImageReload outlived its ImageBitmap reason.

title: The zones' minimap box: shown, held back, handed to the Wheel's box
what it tracks: 52 px box visibility (zone loading, Wheel hand-over) with memo keys for land, exits, party rims, rail inset.
top concern: Rail inset re-measured only on a canvas-height change; door tiles kept in three hand copies.

title: The Wheel's minimap: per-map build, town pictures held and freed, clock of land-crossing notes
what it tracks: Wheel box build/scale/town-icon holds, and the only caller of land banner, No man's land and land-music notes.
top concern: resetWheelMusic is unreachable, so after a death BroTown plays the death land's track ~8 s; notes freeze whenever the box stops.

title: The maps' ambient life: per-zone glows and pooled drifting particles
what it tracks: Zone config, persistent glows and age-driven pooled particles; plays only on retired old-map zones.
top concern: No destroy and an untrimmed pool, bounded by caps; idle in the Wheel.

title: The dev frame-rate overlay
what it tracks: ?dev=1 DOM overlay: 5-minute frame history, 250 ms redraw throttle, console summaries.
top concern: Fed Date.now() though it assumes a monotonic clock; destroy deletes globals without an owner check.

title: A monster move's warning, drawn: lane, fan, ring, two rings, a ring that follows
what it tracks: Drawing half of S._telegraphZones (created by gameEvents, aged out by effectsRenderer) by move shape.
top concern: The follow shape writes tz.x/tz.y from the renderer; harmless while nothing else reads an entry.

title: The parked-tab canvas witness check
what it tracks: Pixels noted on packed canvases, read back on return or rebuild; two empties trigger the recovery reload.
top concern: Since v2.3.3702 the big packed sheets become images (canvas zeroed, witness skipped); worker-baked masked frames were never witnessed, so a purge can go unnoticed.

title: A made-once canvas kept as an image of itself
what it tracks: A canvas source encoded to PNG, swapped to an , canvas zeroed; one stored promise dedupes asks.
top concern: A toBlob that never calls back leaves the promise pending forever and the source unprotected.

title: Pictures kept on the graphics chip only
what it tracks: Canvas emptied once uploaded (now, or once drawn via a pending set); a rebuilt renderer must remake them.
top concern: keepOnGpuOnly has no lost-context guard; damage-font safety rests on a regex matching the font's install list.

title: A monster strip held as colour numbers once drawn
what it tracks: Packed strip read to numbers after first draw, canvas emptied, refilled from numbers on any upload.
top concern: Pending set drops destroyed sources only when a sweep runs; brief strong references between effects renderers.

title: The Wheel's monster looks, loaded as you walk toward them
what it tracks: Per-look loading/ready/failed states by distance and land, freed after 10 s unused, reset on zone change.
top concern: Freeing one look unloads a shared module (bogLurker/fishman) under a sibling still 'ready'; its monsters then draw as the generic brute.

title: Zone art bundles and the unload generation
what it tracks: Per-bundle URLs and cropped strips, freed together; a generation number drops strips decoding across an unload.
top concern: Assets-tracked loads (fireballs, remnants, footprints) are not generation-guarded; sequential unload awaits can destroy a re-entry's cached texture.

title: The world trial's streamed island ground
what it tracks: Pieces of the ?trial=world island loaded near the camera, kept one ring out, freed beyond.
top concern: A piece freed and re-wanted mid-load: the first arrival unloads the url under the second record.

title: Depth buckets: which side of the player each thing draws on
what it tracks: Front/back layer per ground-standing child with 2 px hysteresis, plus the raise over a building's real base.
top concern: On retired props the raise and the hysteresis disagree each frame, moving a figure twice a frame (both layers rebuilt).

title: A metal piece's shine: pooled filter or drawn in the frame
what it tracks: Each metal sprite filtered, batched by the sheen batcher, or plain, chosen per frame and routed at draw-list build.
top concern: Glint, sheen and fill programs are warmed once a page; after a black-screen rebuild the first armoured player compiles them mid-frame.

title: Colour-number atlas rows
what it tracks: 256-row colour atlas: rows taken per picture, shared per bundle, per look; given back on destroy/unload.
top concern: Correctness depends on unloadBundle destroying strips before giving their shared rows back.

title: Shadows: pieces, per-figure hold, pre-pass or filter
what it tracks: Per-renderer shadow pools drawn by a pre-pass or a filter, a 1.5 s hold per caster, cleared on zone/sheet frees.
top concern: Unused pooled meshes keep building textures (sprites drop theirs); safe only while every art free clears the systems first.

title: Light-and-shine switches and the Wheel's eased land light
what it tracks: Per-device light and sheen switches with an on-to-off clear, and the Wheel light eased between lands.
top concern: Turning light effects on at runtime leaves the shine programs unwarmed (gated on the switch at load).

title: The masked-body bake worker's state and replies
what it tracks: Worker keeps the rod mask and parsed look sheets; every bake or look job gets one reply by id.
top concern: A look sheet whose parse fails in the worker stays marked sent; its looks fall back to the old path silently.

title: Does this renderer draw colour numbers (one program or three)?
what it tracks: Per-renderer palette and one-batch decision made by a prewarm draw and link check behind the loading screen.
top concern: A rebuild whose prewarm fails to link still routes existing palette sources to the unlinked palette batcher.

title: Effects' colour numbers packed on the chip (p256)
what it tracks: Dormant ?p256=1: numbers deflated once on the chip, unpacked before any upload, blank upload while packed.

title: A picture from a file held once (picsOnce)
what it tracks: fx/ui pictures release their page copy once on the chip, restored from file on unload, loss or blank upload.
top concern: A failed restore after a blank upload has no retry: a picture drawn every frame stays an empty texture until reload.

title: Which batcher draws a quad: the hook chain and install latches
what it tracks: Up to five prototype wrappers route each quad and its rounding; page-life install latches for every Pixi patch.
top concern: Routing depends on install order and whether each wrapper assigns before or after the inner chain; each claims the last word.

title: The farm's palette reader worker lifecycle
what it tracks: png8 reader worker made on demand, stopped after 3 s idle or on error; failures load as pictures.
top concern: test() and load() ask paletteFileFor separately; a decision between them falls back to the plain loader (harmless).

title: A look given up on, asked for again later
what it tracks: Per-key retry rounds at 5/10/20/40/60 s, ten at most, started when a missing picture is asked for.
top concern: Round counts never reset on success and due closures linger for keys nobody asks for again.

title: A frame that threw leaves Pixi's stacks open; heal closes them
what it tracks: After a throwing render, stencil, colour mask, filter stack and sprite-mask stages reset to nothing open.
top concern: Five Pixi-private fields; a rename makes the heal a silent no-op and the black screen returns.

title: Pixi's texture pool trimmed when idle or at a zone change
what it tracks: Pooled scratch textures stamped when handed back, destroyed after 30 s idle or all at a zone change.

title: Which zone maps are resident (sync mirror of async cache)
what it tracks: A Set mirroring Pixi's cache for the zone gate; live only for the farm's ground today.
top concern: Mirror dropped before an awaited unload: a quick way back re-adds a texture the unload then destroys.

title: A live switch read where a sprite is packed
what it tracks: Window switches boxed for the batchers; a flip marks every render group for a draw-list rebuild.

title: A big Graphics' building lists let go once drawn
what it tracks: Unbatched, drawn, clean Graphics contexts have Pixi's geometry lists emptied; a redraw refills them.
top concern: If Pixi rebuilds its GPU copy without marking the context dirty, the minimap draws from emptied lists, silently.

title: Recoloured body sheet cache: lazy bake, bounded retry, later rounds, drawing drop
what it tracks: Per-look recoloured body sheets: absent, loading, baked, given up, later round, dropped on a drawing edit.
top concern: buildBodySheet's retry is not chained into its promise, so the loading screen passes with a facing on backoff; drops race in-flight bakes.

title: Head-overlay sheet cache with its 32-sheet cap
what it tracks: Pickup/jog/hit/mine head sheets per skin, eye style and face drawing, capped at 32 with local-player protection.
top concern: The cap's local-combo guard still includes trousers/boots that the head key dropped (v2.3.3658), so non-default dressers' own heads are evicted first.

title: Gear sheet cache with chained retry, later rounds and the drawn-shirt LRU
what it tracks: Gear and dressed-tee sheets: absent, loading, loaded, given up, later round; dressings evicted by an 8-key LRU.
top concern: Nine dressings on screen cascade the LRU: every frame evicts and rebuilds every dressed tee, releasing sources a sprite is still drawing.

title: The worn armour layer: derived from stat pieces but still written by cosmetic paths
what it tracks: Per-slot drawn armour layer in localStorage, meant to mirror the server's worn stat pieces.
top concern: InventoryPanel's Legs Unequip always takes the cosmetic path: art off, stat greaves still worn and mitigating, a costume duplicate saved.

title: Local look stores and the prewarms their changes trigger
what it tracks: Skin/trousers/boots stores in localStorage, each change prewarming the stand sheets of the new combo.
top concern: Eye colour is in the sheet key but triggers no prewarm; a batch look change bakes every intermediate combo and never frees them.

title: The look palette: sets, program link, and each look's atlas row
what it tracks: Colour-number sheet sets, the shader program per renderer, and per-look palette rows swept after 30 s idle.
top concern: A set that fails once is never retried, so phones draw copies for the visit; a failed set can end half-present.

title: Body under armour from the numbers: per-frame decided states, books, mask atlas
what it tracks: Per (look, worn set, sheet) frame states undecided/asked/decided via worker jobs, plus masked-look rows and books.
top concern: A failed frame (beltPending, gear not loaded) goes back to undecided and is re-asked every draw with no backoff.

title: Dressed tee from the numbers: dressings cache, live switch, fallback chain

what it tracks: Slime-sheet death splat: playing on its own clock, over at SPLAT_MS, disposed once.

what it tracks: Minted shot atlas lifecycle plus a record per flying ball, landing effects and capped particle/mark lists.

what it tracks: Blue slime recolour cache entry: async per-sheet build, per-state readiness, free on zone exit or Wheel look release.

what it tracks: Per-monster silhouette riding a covering prop: shown, hidden, freed after 1.5 s or when its host goes.

title: Art tables that time other files' phases: snowman throw and burrow, mummy shred
what it tracks: Frame splits and clamp/wrap rules for the snowman's throw and burrow and the mummy's shred; explicit halves.
top concern: Owning slice: the burrow's tick fallback keeps a stale _burFrom and a 400 ms _burUntil, so a missed event plays wrong.

title: A building's fire: face, rubble, going out, gone
what it tracks: A hit building's fire through face, rubble and out modes, split across a fires Map and a going list.
top concern: Self-timeout and heap-gone exits leave an 'out' fire in the Map, swallowing new hits on that building for up to 4.2 s.

what it tracks: The building's flames on a burning figure: made once, lit, dying down, hidden and reused; peers released when done.

what it tracks: One campfire Fire through light, adoption by its campfire record, fuse burn-down and dying, fed by four record sources.
top concern: A peer's light is adopted only if campfire_lit lands before their 'fire' code stops being drawn; reordered, two fires show.

title: A monster's wind-up look (the phone's copy of the worker's telegraph)
what it tracks: The phone's copy of a monster's wind-up window, drawn as its element's swirl and a body throb.
top concern: Shield Bash and parry cancel the worker's wind-up, but nothing clears the phone's _tgUntil; the warning plays on up to 1.2 s.

title: A swimmer drawn in the water: wading in, swimming or treading, climbing out
what it tracks: A figure sinking into the water, swimming or treading, and climbing out, with hysteresis and teleport snaps for peers.
top concern: A peer's swim is decided from this screen's drawn ground; where it is not laid yet, they are drawn standing in the water.

title: A jumper drawn in the air, and the touch-down squash
what it tracks: A jumper lifted, stretched and leaned in the air, then squashed on landing; peers' spent jumps cleared here.
top concern: A draw pass ends a peer's jump state, only for peers with a display; every reader checks the time, so harmless.

title: The skateboard under a rider: on, view, rolling, bump, off

top concern: The bump sets _jumpY, so emoteFx thinks a rider is airborne: a cheer or flex flickers on each bump; tilting moves cancel bumps.

title: A figure's borrowed transform each frame: swim, jump, board, emote
what it tracks: Swim, jump, board and emote passes each patch and restore the same figure transform every frame, in a fixed order.
top concern: Order-dependent write-and-restore across four passes with cross-read marks; the board bump already breaks emotes, and reordering risks stuck tilts.

title: A trap drawn: the mark, then a spring's drop, shakes, snap or break
what it tracks: The trap's mark ring and each spring's drop, shakes, snap or break, timed beside trapping.js's setTimeout beats.
top concern: Mark and springs carry no zone and S._trap survives a zone change; a door taken within 15 s draws the ring in the dungeon.

title: Soot marks from a slime's blast: queued, live and fading, gone
what it tracks: Ten pooled soot marks from slime blasts, live and fading for a minute, ended on leaving their zone.

title: The shared fx strips: loading at import, ready, or failed for good
what it tracks: Global effect strips loading at import, ready or failed for good; every reader falls back while frames are empty.

title: The white-hot bow special: in flight, struck, smouldering, burnt out or flaring
what it tracks: The bow special's white-hot look: flight, strike, a throb per chip tick, then burning out or flaring for a blast.
top concern: LIFE_MS and TICK_MS are unpinned hand copies of projectiles.js's stuck-arrow timing, so the drawn throbs could drift.

title: The staff cast: charging, release, the bolt easing off the crystal, the crash and burst
what it tracks: The staff crystal's charge, release flash, bolt easing off the crystal, and crash burst, edge-detected from cast stamps.

title: The Goo Grotto's moving bits: drips, bubbles, torch fires, spores, ferns
what it tracks: The Goo Grotto's drips, bubbles, glints, torch fires and spores, each with explicit wait-grow-fall phases on timers.

title: Each land's trees and rocks wearing their element
what it tracks: Per-resource element speck pools near the view, born and gone by alpha alone, with drips hanging then falling.

title: A building's life: smoke, lamps, sparks, glints, chaff, and the Town Hall's cut flag
what it tracks: Chimney smoke, lamps, sparks, glints and chaff on Wheel buildings, and the Town Hall flag cut out of its page.

title: The sky by the hour: plain day, golden-hour tint, or a night light map
what it tracks: Plain day, golden-hour tint or a rendered night light map, chosen each frame; held at midday on the Wheel.
top concern: Night is dormant on the Wheel by the owner's call; it runs only on the farm and the retired old lands.

title: The world's small motions: sway springs, chop kicks, breathing, ore glints
what it tracks: Sway springs with chop kicks, NPC and monster breathing, and ore glint riders; the old town's building riders are retired.
top concern: Building riders, prop sway and canopies run only for old-map props, and no prop exists on the Wheel.

title: The slice's code-drawn pictures: minted once on a canvas and kept
what it tracks: Ten code-drawn effect pictures minted once on canvases and kept; only elemWindup and sootMarks are kept as images.
top concern: Eight kept canvases skip keepAsImage (TRAPS §253); after Safari empties canvases or a rebuild, fires, blood, dust, auras and smoke can draw blank.

title: The Wheel objects' sprite-sheet pages (wanted, loading, ready, failed, dropped)
what it tracks: Each object sprite sheet streamed in near the view, kept as colour numbers or a picture, dropped when far.
top concern: A failed page is never retried while you stay near: its buildings and trees stay invisible and walk-through until you go 1000 px away.

what it tracks: A broken object's shards: falling, bouncing, lying in a heap until mended or pushed out by the pixel cap.

what it tracks: Per drawn sprite: eased see-through alpha under a crown, times the mend fade-in alpha.
top concern: A repair whose break event was lost fades a never-removed tree in from zero: a blink.

title: The Wheel's ground pieces (wanted, laying, laid, short, re-laying, freed) and the overview under them
what it tracks: Per 192 px ground piece: asked of the worker, laid, re-laid when a missing picture comes, freed when far.

title: The moving water: the program (untried, built, cannot) and a quad per piece hiding the ground under open sea
what it tracks: Whether this device draws moving water, and each ground piece's water quad hiding open-sea ground.
top concern: The built/cannot answer is decided against the first renderer only; a rebuilt one compiles the program on its first water frame.

title: The farm's pictures (loading, ready, freed) under a generation stamp
what it tracks: The farm's art set loaded behind the farm trip's hold and freed on leaving, stamped by generation.

what it tracks: Each bed's soil, crop stage and label redrawn from the worker's farm_state; a ripe chime edge; work beats.

title: A dungeon arena's furnishings and the boss's chest (dropping, shut, open, glinting)

title: The dropped-item picture cache (loading, ready, failed, unheld, gone) with hold counts
what it tracks: Per bag picture: loading, ready, failed or trimmed, held by piles and drop lines, at most 24 unheld kept.
top concern: A failed picture is never fetched again while its entry lives: that item stays a stand-in mark.

title: A kill's drop lines (built, staggered in, rising, fading, gone) over a list two sides write
what it tracks: Each kill's drop group: built, rebuilt when a late line arrives, lines staggered in and faded, pruned by both sides.
top concern: A throw part-way through building a group leaves earlier lines' picture holds never released.

title: The preloaded icon sets: coin piles, rare-loot icons, the resource tools

title: A resource's label (built, tool alone, full pill, hidden, killed)

what it tracks: The snow-print strip per zone: loaded behind the zone's overlay, sliced, slices dropped before the unload on leaving.
top concern: Leaving mid-load lets slices of the destroyed picture be stored; the next visit trusts them: no prints for the session.

title: How each drawn Wheel object casts its shadow (waiting, columns, billboard, building)
what it tracks: A per-sprite caster record switching from billboard to columns once its picture's bases are read.

title: The old map's prop ground profile (unmeasured, measured, unreadable)
what it tracks: A measure-once ground profile on each old-map prop sprite; only 'town' and 'frost' props, both retired.

title: The buildings' life on the Wheel, lost after a black-screen rebuild
what it tracks: Building life textures made by the way-in warm only, freed by every WheelObjects destroy, read at sprite creation.
top concern: After a rebuild in the Wheel nothing re-warms them: BroTown's smoke, lamps and flags are gone until you leave and re-enter.

what it tracks: Each monster's alive/respawn, resolver phases, ball in flight, sticky aggro, chase, wind-ups, leash and wander, ticked per zone.
top concern: A ball in the air when its thrower dies is never cleared, so it lands from the previous life on the first tick after respawn.

what it tracks: Alive, dying for 5 s, respawned in town; the phone's death screen, its watchdog and the owed-respawn replay.
top concern: Monster aggro, PvP targeting and NML skip players on ps.dead, which the phone writes on every move: a modified phone is untouchable.

title: A game socket's life on the worker (open, joined, closed) and its close codes
what it tracks: Session from upgrade through pre-join, joining, joined, AFK, flood, takeover and close; the tick loop it keeps alive.

top concern: A same-id takeover (second tab, quick relaunch) skips the linger and reloads HP up to 10 s stale: an escape plus a heal.

title: The world map's watch on far players (presence v2)
what it tracks: A per-session 8 s lease renewed by the open map, a fresh-send flag, and a 30 s online list.

what it tracks: Token minted at join, enforced or legacy, valid only while the session lives.
top concern: Between setting session.id and minting the token a header-less request passes as legacy; only storage awaits sit there today.

title: A bundle's parts, one after another (the quiet phone)
what it tracks: An array frame cut to 24 non-join parts, each awaited in order with the session re-read.

title: A pile of loot on the ground (kill piles, death piles, drops)
what it tracks: Four claim lanes, owner and free windows, private minute, expiry and despawn on one in-memory pile.
top concern: Every pile, including a death pile holding a whole bag, is lost on a room restart (documented and accepted).

title: A player's shield: raised, parry window, held, broken
