top concern: Nothing separates two raises, so a phone dropping the shield for one move every ~240 ms parries every blow it blocks.

title: A phone's relay to the room (allowlist, budget, rebuild, intercepts)
what it tracks: Privileged drop, allowlist, social lane or bucket, rebuild in the sender's name, handshake intercepts, fan-out.
top concern: A peer's corpse is set and cleared only by the dying phone's relays; a respawn while its tab sleeps leaves a corpse on every screen.

title: "In a fight or not" and the pools' regen (with its paced save)
what it tracks: Two combat stamps read by seven different windows; regen modes; coalesced pool saves flushed on close.
top concern: Seven unnamed fight windows in seven files; index.js:3640 computes one never read.

title: The PvP consent pairs (duel, arena, threat)
what it tracks: A pair map of until-stamps written by duel, arena and threat, read by six identical checks.
top concern: Lapsed pairs linger until death or disconnect; _pvpChallenges is walked but never written.

title: Memory savers turned off for every phone (client_off)
what it tracks: Live off_ flags sent as one list at join and on every change; the phone keeps the last word.

title: A copy's page refused (the origin lock)
what it tracks: Stateless origin check; one refusal message and close 4015; the phone shows the origin screen and stops.

title: The leaderboard report's throttle
what it tracks: Per-session clock and signature, stamped before the cross-object fetch, forced at join.

title: The round-trip measurement (ping and pong)
what it tracks: Ping every ~3 s; only the latest ping's pong is a sample, held time removed, smoothed and capped.
top concern: A phone answering after the next ping never samples, so the PvP rewind keeps a stale RTT.

title: What a paid ability opens (ability_use: the roll, the special, the retreat)
what it tracks: Pool charged, then a 1 s roll window, special windows or retreat shots that later hits read.
top concern: ability_use refuses dying but not the parry stagger every sibling handler refuses, so a staggered player still buys dodge i-frames.

title: The join's admission pipeline (one socket from upgrade to joined)
what it tracks: A socket's session from upgrade through auth, refusals, eviction, state build and state_sync, keyed on session.id.
top concern: Second-login eviction skips webSocketClose, so a second tab escapes a No man's land fight (no linger) with bag and stale HP.

title: The owed respawn replayed at a rejoin
what it tracks: ps._respawnOwed marks a respawn the phone never heard, to be replayed after the next join's state_sync.
top concern: Dead code: the join reads the flag off the player state it just rebuilt from scratch, so the replay never fires.

title: The per-character wrong-key lockout
what it tracks: _authFails id -> {count, until}: five wrong keys lock an id for 60 s, shared by join and login door.
top concern: Two copies of the counter disagree (retired old key counts at the join, not at the door); counts never decay.

title: The login door's per-address throttle
what it tracks: _acctIp ip -> {count, windowStart}: 20 tries a minute per address at /api/account.

title: One change at a time to a login record (_authSerial)
what it tracks: Per-id promise chain serialising every read-modify-write of auth:<id> across gate-opening awaits.
top concern: Relies on never re-entering for the same id; a future close hook touching auth: would deadlock that id's joins.

title: A character's devices: the device lock and its one-time fill
what it tracks: auth.devs/pass/sealed decide open-first, known, pass or refuse for a key from a device; plus a once-ever fill.
top concern: On a cold worker the login door and restart ignore devicelock:false (flags only warmed for sockets), refusing new devices the switch should admit.

title: Login keys: each key's life and a new character's first key retired
what it tracks: auth.keys made/used/taken back, keyidx index, and fresh -> oldGone retirement of a phone-made first key.
top concern: Wide cross product of pfHash/fresh/oldGone/keys/devs/sealed/pass with five writers and a phone mirror; a wrong-id new key spends another id's lockout.

title: The account check (Turnstile) at a new character's first join
what it tracks: Refused 'verify' with site key, the phone's widget, then a join carrying a token verified by an outside fetch.
top concern: The verify fetch opens the input gate before session.id is set (ghost body, second join per socket); latent while TURNSTILE_SITEKEY is empty.

title: Test mode: the owner's characters without the honesty checks
what it tracks: testmode:<pid> record copied to ps._testMode at join, overridden room-wide by the testmode kill switch.
top concern: _sigReverifyOk reads the stored record, not _testMode(ps), so with testmode:false thrown a test character still skips the bot re-check.

title: The Wheel's arrival with only the monsters near you
what it tracks: session.wheelNear plus _wheelWhole/_wheelSeen sets seeded per arrival, cleared leaving the Wheel; mw sends a monster whole once.

title: Which players' looks a near-join phone holds
what it tracks: session._looks, _snapSeq and per-player _lookWholeSeq decide when a look goes whole (pl) or as a list entry.

title: Where the server last had you: the reconnect's judge
what it tracks: _lastPlaces remembered at a leave, taken once by the next join, with Wheel way-back fields on the player state.
top concern: Memory only: the first join after a deploy or idle eviction is never judged (documented); split with movement.js across five fields.

title: The coalesced record save: dirty until flushed
what it tracks: _regenDirty/_regenSaveAt coalesce pools, HP above 25% and paced taps into one write per 10 s, flushed on close.
top concern: The second-login eviction drops the dirty state unflushed, so a second tab rolls back up to 10 s of coalesced PvP and monster damage.

title: The record's shape version: migrate on load, stamp on save
what it tracks: blob._v and the in-memory _rpgSaveV note drive the append-only migration table; newer saves refused at join.

title: The v2 player_state delta: what this session was last told
what it tracks: session.lastPlayerStateSent caches each field last sent so v2 gets changes only; v1 gets the full state.

title: A character restart: snapshot, wipe, then the player leaves
what it tracks: Ordered snapshot and deletion of a dozen per-character keys and caches, state dropped before the leave runs.

title: The live flags cache: unloaded, loaded, written through
what it tracks: this._liveFlags lazily loaded; every kill switch read synchronously from it; null reads as nothing thrown.
top concern: /api/account and /api/admin are routed before the only warm-up, so a cold worker reads every kill switch as untouched there.

title: The daily economy record: a paged job across three tables
what it tracks: _metricsJob cursor walks rpg, inbox, orders one page a tick slot; day stamp and an hour's back-off.

title: The sticky announcement (MOTD)
what it tracks: Stored motd present or absent, broadcast on announce and sent on every join.

title: The hidden settings: placeholders until the record is read
what it tracks: _hiddenLoaded/_hiddenTable merged over public placeholders; newer record never written; hidden_off kill switch.
top concern: Admin view and botflags read hidden_off without loading flags, so a cold worker shows private values as in force (display only).

title: The owner's levers: freeze, kick, restore
what it tracks: frozen:<pid> join gate, kick and freeze put-outs, and an offline-only snapshot restore with a parachute.
top concern: Restore checks only for a socket; a kicked fighter's lingering body saves its old state over the restored blob within 20 s.

title: The daily rollback snapshots and their two rings
what it tracks: rpgsnap_at 20 h throttle and daily/parachute rings of 7, taken at join before the record changes.

title: The owner's test kit on a live player: god mode, refills, quest jumps
what it tracks: ps._godUntil timed immunity; refills, unlocks and quest-state writes from the admin-key Test panel.
top concern: A refill while dying clears dead/dying without respawn, so the server keeps them in place while the phone's watchdog puts them in town.

title: Hemi Bro ownership: nonce, verify, a stored link that goes stale
what it tracks: session._broNonce handshake, bro_link fresh/stale with a background re-read, ps.bro/broN badge.
top concern: A background refresh from the old link can land after a fresh verify and write the old wallet's badge back.

title: The character record: a look and a name written once
what it tracks: char:<id> first-write-wins; absent means creating now, a missing key means blank; stamped over every join and relay.
top concern: The stored shape has no version number for a future look migration.

title: One-time captures at the join: absent means not taken in yet
what it tracks: goldNuggets typeof, gemsCaptured, gearStashCaptured, empty weapon tracks and absent prog3 gate a one-time client claim.
top concern: A stored record with empty weaponSkills re-takes the phone's sanitized claim on every join (legacy track, also stats_update-writable).

title: A guard's gear lock carried across a reconnect
what it tracks: gearlock:<pid> timestamp restored into ps._gearLockUntil at join; expires by time.
top concern: Expired gearlock keys are never deleted.

title: The room's tick loop: start, pace, stop
what it tracks: The 45 Hz heartbeat's handle, pacer re-arms and stop on the last close, across index.js, tick.js, tickpace.js.
top concern: Party tick, regen, flush, AFK sweep and the whole send loop run outside the per-system guard; one repeating throw silences the room.

title: Idle (AFK) and never-joined socket eviction
what it tracks: A session's activity clock, stamped by move signature, swept every ~3 s with close 4006.

title: The dead/dying pair, with the phone writing dead on every move
what it tracks: Worker's dying/respawn plus the phone's dead flag, overwritten by every accepted move and trusted by targeting.
top concern: A phone sending dead:true while alive is skipped by every monster and PvP hit loop yet still attacks monsters: god mode.

title: The shield: down, raised (parry window), held, guard-broken
what it tracks: Phone-written blocking, the server-stamped raise time that opens the parry window, and the guard-break latch.
top concern: Toggling blocking every move re-arms the 250 ms parry window endlessly: near-every blocked blow parried, free, stamina back, attacker staggered.

title: The move budget: first move, judged, followed, way back into the Wheel
what it tracks: Anti-teleport budget, the tick's follow, and the way-back/arrival holders deciding where a move is judged from.
top concern: A follow moves the copy with no race or ride check; many holders and two kill switches decide judging.

title: The glide (message diet): a steady walk moved between moves
what it tracks: ps._mp glide between a phone's pd:1 moves, stopped by any foreign write, rewound before the next judge.
top concern: A ride ended by a hit clears the glide without rewinding, so one move is judged from the glided spot.

title: Steady movers: a walker's update held for the next tick
what it tracks: Per-player last-sent record deciding hold-or-send of a Wheel walker's update each tick.

title: Sprint: a step the worker pays for, a run, the grace after
what it tracks: Per-move sprint step, run continuity, stamina billing, grace and wire/regen windows from five underscore fields.
top concern: With the diet's 200 ms gaps, the stretch before a non-sprint stop goes unbilled; small and by design.

title: The skateboard ride
what it tracks: ps._ride on/off with toggle cooldown, ended by edge, zone, death, hit, fighting, duel, kill switch, ask.
top concern: Ride ends only on an accepted move; glide and follow can carry a rider past the safe edge still drawn on the board.

title: Lil Bro's race
what it tracks: ps._race countdown, false start, five flags along each step, win/lose, ended only from accepted moves.
top concern: No sweep ends a stale race (ride refused 'busy'); a death does not end it while the phone's copy keeps its own clock.

title: Rest and Well Rested
what it tracks: A gated rest filling pools and stamping the saved Well Rested buff, with a memory-only minute gap.
top concern: A reconnect lets one rest through early (documented, costs one row).

title: The paid roll window
what it tracks: Phone's dodging counts only inside the window a charged dodge/lunge/retreat opened (1000 ms).
top concern: Monster-blow i-frames ignore a daze or freeze while both player-blow readers refuse a dazed roll.

title: A player's elemental statuses from monster hits
what it tracks: Chill, freeze, stuck, daze, soak and gust-room windows stamped by the worker, mostly carried out by the phone.
top concern: Of a daze's 'no walk, swing, roll or shield' the worker enforces only PvP swings, PvP rolls and ability strikes.

title: Burns, poisons and stings on a player
what it tracks: Per-player DOT Maps refreshed by hits and swept every tick by every exit.
top concern: Put-out reads the phone-written ps.dead (part of S3-3).

title: Zone change and the zone-entry grace
what it tracks: Phone-chosen zone per move: snapshot, per-zone resets and a 500 ms damage-immunity grace on each entry.
top concern: A two-move bundle wheel→dungeon:x→wheel re-arms the grace at no position cost; repeated, permanent immunity (monsters and PvP).

title: Who a phone is sent about: far players, the slim roster, presence v2
what it tracks: Room and session holders deciding whole, slim, skipped or hidden player entries in each phone's tick.
top concern: Four kill switches, two dormant paths and per-session flags must agree across both tick builders.

title: The Wheel's monster interest per phone
what it tracks: Per-session seen/entered monster sets with in/out hysteresis, forgotten outside the Wheel.
top concern: A target dropped out of reach never reaches the phone, so the next notice of you shows no '!' cue.

title: Wheel monsters awake or resting, and the safe ground's shelter vs provoke
what it tracks: Per-tick rest test for far monsters and the safe ground's shelter unless the player provoked the monster.
top concern: The 'nothing in flight' list is hand-written in three places; each new monster phase must join all three.

title: Which Wheel the room plays and a phone in or out of step
what it tracks: Room latches long/short Wheel once; each player in or out of step by the sizes its phone declared.
top concern: A phone declaring ws:[1] (or none) is never a monster's target or hit, yet may attack monsters freely.

title: Monster moves past tier 1
what it tracks: Per-monster wind-up, strike, dash, flight, cooldowns, enrage and live stat step in thirteen _mv fields.
top concern: A monster killed mid-volley drops balls the phone was told to land; reset lists kept by hand.

title: Population-scaled spawns
what it tracks: Held zone population with instant rise and slow decay growing and trimming scaled monsters and nodes.
top concern: Runs only for zones with a config; the Wheel has none, so only the closed old lands reach it.

title: Threats: countdown, guards or consent
what it tracks: Threat pairs with countdown, guards fine and gear lock, consent window and bounty payout.
top concern: Dormant: OPEN_PVP is false; gearlock storage keys are never deleted.

title: Cadence: the login streak and the weekly jackpot
what it tracks: Stored login streak with freezes and the lazily settled, opId-stamped weekly jackpot draw.
top concern: A retry after a restart re-rolls the winner: payment is dup-safe but the announcement names the wrong player.

title: stats_update: the legacy skill tracks' level-up full restore
what it tracks: Phone-reported legacy weapon/defence skill levels; any increase fills HP, stamina and mana.
top concern: Under prog3 honest phones never raise these tracks, so each forged +1 is a free full heal, ~400 per character.

title: Legacy build points, T2 allocation and the pre-prog3 level
what it tracks: Build points to level, T2 spend, bench-priced t2Flat and the 1000-point ceiling, all off under prog3.

title: The harvest activity code (ex) and the cook/fire shield it arms
what it tracks: Phone-written ex whose null-to-active edge anchors the cook/fire harvest shield that monsters respect.
top concern: Swing, then ex:null and ex:'cook' in one bundle re-arms the shield before any tick: monsters never fight back.

title: The lag-compensation history
what it tracks: Per-player ring of 14 reused tick snapshots read by the PvP rewind, deleted on every way out.

title: A monster's telegraphed kit cast (slam, lunge, roar)
what it tracks: A monster's signature cast: ready, winding up, executing, cooling; cancelled by stun, parry, respawn.
top concern: A blue slime killed mid-lunge-windup still lunges from its 0-HP swelling corpse; the split boss's swell also leaves its cast running.

title: A blue slime's death swell (the deferred kill)
what it tracks: Kill deferred 1.6 s while the slime swells at 0 HP, then the blast and the replayed kill.
top concern: The swell clears only the basic wind-up: the kit cast and a thrown ball run on through the swell into the next life.

title: A monster's ball in the air (snowball, slime ball)
what it tracks: Thrown ball: aim point and release frozen, lands after travelMs if the target stayed near.
top concern: Not cleared on death, swell or respawn: a ball thrown just before a kill lands from the respawned monster about 19 s later.

title: The melee lifesteal ledger (what each monster has dealt you)
what it tracks: Per player, the damage each monster id dealt; refunded 90% on your melee kill of that id.
top concern: Cleared only on zone change or death, and the Wheel is one zone: a respawned monster's previous-life damage is refunded.

title: A monster's basic swing or throw wind-up
what it tracks: Stamp-then-resolve basic attack: wind-up, re-measured whiff, then a swing hit or a ball release.
top concern: An elemental freeze during the wind-up stops movement but not the stamped swing; only a stun or a parry cancels it.

title: The snowman's burrow (dig, pile, emerge)
what it tracks: Snowman at half HP digs, becomes an invulnerable chasing pile, emerges vulnerable; a facing shield bonks it early.
top concern: The pile ignores crowd control while it grinds after you.

title: The giant slime boss's splits
what it tracks: Boss health floored at each quarter mark; it swells unhittable, blasts, spawns slimes and shrinks, three times.
top concern: The split swell stops the boss script and basic wind-up but not its fodder lunge kit or a monster move in flight.

title: May this monster be hit? (the damage-denial gate)
what it tracks: One predicate (alive, hp, split floor, invulnerable window) that every monster damage door should ask.
top concern: Element Burst and the staff splash pick targets by alive and hp only, so the burst stamps statuses on an invulnerable pile or boss.

title: A monster's death and its settlement (credit, loot, XP, heals, traps)
what it tracks: Kill: credit shares, loot pile, kill roll, heals, XP, quests, codex, traps, respawn clock, contributions cleared.
top concern: Eight entry points plus a deferred replay behind a set-and-clear latch; a new await or skipped path breaks settlement.

title: A player taking damage (grace, god mode, dodge, Last Stand, Second Wind)
what it tracks: The one place player HP drops: grace and god windows, dodge, cuts, Last Stand, Second Wind.
top concern: Callers, not _applyDamage, check ps.dying; harmless today.

title: A monster's blow through the one door, and the shield that meets it
what it tracks: Fifteen kinds of monster blow, one ordered pipeline: shield, shelter, miss, block or parry, dice, after-effects, death.
top concern: A blocked monster blow that empties stamina does not break the guard, unlike PvP, leaving about 0.66 s of free blocks.

title: Proof a hit on a monster was earned (cadence lanes, hit-rate bucket, paid special windows)
what it tracks: Per-player cadence lanes, ranged hit-rate tokens and paid special windows gating monster_damage claims.

title: A player's blow at a player (lag-comp rewind, lanes, block, parry, guard break)
what it tracks: PvP claim resolved against rewound positions, consent, per-pair lanes, block, parry, guard break and the worker's roll.
top concern: The attacker's death gate runs before a thorn recoil that can kill them, so a dead attacker's blow still lands.

title: Element statuses on a monster and the hold rule
what it tracks: Per-monster statuses with durations, stacks, DoT ticks and collisions; freeze or root holds, then immunity.
top concern: Durations count ticks but DoTs count wall time; refreshes move credit; the burst stamps statuses on protected monsters.

title: The collision resonance streak
what it tracks: Resonating collisions build a 10 s streak that pays mana, throttled to once every 3 s.

title: Stamina abilities, lunge and Element Burst: cooldowns and the whirlwind's wind-up
what it tracks: Per-kind cooldown stamps and a 1 s armed whirlwind, paid at the press, struck from where you stand.
top concern: An armed whirlwind is not re-checked for a parry stagger when it fires.

title: Ground fire: the fire goblin's trail and a burning heap
what it tracks: Per-zone fire patches arming, burning and expiring; one burn tick per player per 500 ms.
top concern: Per-player burn clocks and dungeon zones' patch arrays are never freed; dungeon cleanup skips fireTrails.

title: Sticky aggro and knockback debt
what it tracks: A hit pulls the monster onto its attacker for 10 s; shoves leave a capped debt repaid while chasing.

title: One roll a kill
what it tracks: Each kill rolls 1 to 10,000; the drop it lands on is minted, then told to whoever may have it.

title: The bow special's final blast (arrow_blast)
what it tracks: Retired coordinate-named blast, refused while the volley is live, with a cooldown and a refusal ledger.
top concern: The refusal ledger is never pruned (tiny).

title: A dropped bag item on the ground
what it tracks: Dropped pile: private 60 s, revealed to the room, flashing at 120 s, gone at 130 s.
top concern: A restart in those two minutes loses the item (documented and accepted).

title: A socket's door and message budget
what it tracks: Per-socket message tokens, a join deadline, one join per socket and per-address open limits.

title: Paced writes (a player's own taps saved at a bounded rate)
what it tracks: Per lane and player token buckets; past the burst the latest write is held and flushed later.
top concern: A held mute-list write lives only in a setTimeout; a deploy in that window loses it.

title: Which shield is on the arm, and the gem in it
what it tracks: Worn shield versus carried ones, with a session-only arm-known flag that No man's land trusts.

title: A weapon's gem slots and the Enchanting XP a made gem is owed
what it tracks: A weapon goes plain, one gem, two gems (fusion); Take out strips both; made gems owe 400 XP.

title: The one-formula switch thrown while players are on
what it tracks: Global formula flag; flipping it re-sizes every live bar and monster hit from a per-monster stamp.
top concern: Phones keep the caps they joined with and predict the old formula until they rejoin.

title: In a fight (the stamps behind out-of-combat healing and the safe ground's shelter)
what it tracks: Damage taken and dealt stamps decide regen, safe-ground heal and shelter; PvP and No man's land keep other clocks.
top concern: Several in-a-fight clocks serve different readers; DoT, splash and collision damage dealt never stamp _lastDealtAt.

title: A blow ends your harvest (the combat side of the extraction machine)
what it tracks: Any monster_damage or PvP claim deletes the sender's extraction record, before the claim's own weapon, reach and rate gates.
top concern: Stuck-arrow chip claims keep arriving 2.5-4 s after a bow special and end a harvest begun meanwhile; its strike is then refused.

title: Old cross-room Arena DO tournament (queue → active → complete)
what it tracks: Retired Arena Durable Object's queue and bracket; unrouted since gladiator.js took /api/arena, kept for its binding.
top concern: If ever re-routed, POST /result trusts any client-claimed winner and the entry fee is client-side.

title: Duel machine (challenge → accept → active → resolved), with wager escrow and away clocks
what it tracks: A two-player duel: challenge, accept with escrowed wagers, active with 15 s away clocks, resolved by kill, forfeit or clock.
top concern: Walking into another zone never ends a duel: 10 minutes with no HP regen, fight-locked bag, and a hider wins the wager on hp fraction.

title: Gladiator arena bracket (gathering → running → complete → cleared)
what it tracks: The room's one tournament: a 60 s gather, rounds of wager-0 arena duels, a crowned champion, then cleared.
top concern: ps._arenaMatch is lost on any reconnect, so a fighter who drops and returns can eat fish and heals mid-match.

title: Arena sponsorship stake (escrowed → settled pool | swept refund)
what it tracks: A spectator's stake on one arena match: escrowed at placement, settled as a pool off the server-observed winner.
top concern: Debit and stamp commit before the arena_stake record is written; a restart between them loses the gold with no record to refund.

title: Sparring session and its clones as fake players
what it tracks: An admin test spar: up to three AI clones living as playerState entries, cleared on leave, zone change or switch.
top concern: Clones are socketless playerState entries; every playerState walker must skip _spar itself (14+ checks in 10 files), so a new walker can miss it.

title: Spar clone AI behaviour loop
what it tracks: One clone's step: idle or engaged, rolling, lunging, shielding, swinging, shooting, knocked down and standing back.
top concern: A copy of the fight simulator's player on the room clock; simulator changes do not reach it.

title: PvP engagement record, directional
what it tracks: Per pair, who struck whom within 10 s, deciding which players area moves may hit.
top concern: At 2048 live pairs the whole map is cleared, forgetting real engagements until the next blow.

title: A player's PvP statuses and holds
what it tracks: Time-gated statuses and holds on a PvP target: element statuses, daze/stuck immunity, stagger, guard break, gust, kill-heal ledger.
top concern: Daze is written by three files with copied logic; the kill-heal ledger survives the attacker's death and refunds an older life's damage.

title: Paid special window
what it tracks: A charged swipe opens three special claims for 3.5 s; outside it a special claim rolls as ordinary.
top concern: A reconnect inside the window forgets it, so a paid special lands as an ordinary hit.

title: No Man's Land skulls (red / white with hit-back rights)
what it tracks: Red and white skulls with per-attacker hit-back rights, counted down in online time, stored in nml_state.
top concern: NML live flags change the worker's rule at once, but phones learn their caps only at the next join, so they disagree meanwhile.

title: No Man's Land kill attribution and the death's loss
what it tracks: The last NML blow within 5 s makes a death an NML kill; the killer takes bag, gold and spares.
top concern: Each loot credit is fire-and-forget; a restart after the victim's save loses that piece for both, deliberately never a duplicate.

title: No Man's Land lock after a red skull's death
what it tracks: A red skull killed by their victim is locked out from attacking them for 30 minutes, stored.
top concern: An older worker's save drops the lock field during a rollback, so locks lapse early; acknowledged.

title: Dungeon instance (start → waves → boss → done → cleaned)
what it tracks: A private run whose membership is standing in its zone; swept when empty, done after its boss.
top concern: Start and party pull never check a duel or arena match, so a dueller is taken into a private zone and the duel becomes unwinnable.

title: Dungeon boss ability cycle
what it tracks: A boss's cast cycle: ready, one-second telegraph, execute, cooldown; charges, capped summons and an enrage ramp.

title: A run's XP ledger and the boss's chest
what it tracks: Fight XP noted per weapon in a dungeon zone, paid flat into those skills, with the chest, at the clear.
top concern: A reconnect mid-run forgets the ledger, so the clear's XP goes to the weapon in hand.

title: On-chain score checkpoint
what it tracks: A level milestone queues a preflight, nonce read, send and receipt wait, then stores chain_score; failures retry next level-up.
top concern: rpcCall's fetch has no timeout, so one hung RPC blocks the room-wide send queue and that player's lane until a restart.

title: Event cape ticket and cape
what it tracks: A contest ticket drops against a cached ledger, is redeemed for a cape, then worn or taken off.
top concern: Before the ledger warms after a restart, a winner's cape is stripped from the relayed look.

title: Event contest switch
what it tracks: Whether the cape contest runs: a source constant, a durable stop flag and rate, and a one-shot start clear.
top concern: The contest's phase spans source, durable flags and a stored id; its history records silent vetoes nobody could see.

title: PvP consent pair shared by duels, arena matches and threats
what it tracks: Pair key to expiry: the damage gate's 'you two may fight', written and cleared by duels, arena and threats.
top concern: One keyspace for three owners: a duel's resolve deletes a threat consent between the same pair; dormant while open PvP is off.

title: Event placement filter
what it tracks: Which phone hears each tick event: placed events by distance or zone, stateful ones kept room-wide by allowlist.
top concern: Correct only against a 2026-10-13 client audit; a client handler keeping state from a placed type would desync far phones.

title: Arena house prize budget
what it tracks: A per-clock-hour house prize counter, loaded once per room life and saved before the champion is paid.
top concern: A failed fire-and-forget save keeps memory right but a later restart restores the older total, adding budget back.

title: The gift trade (trade_offer / trade_accept relay)
what it tracks: One in-memory single-shot gift offer per sender>target, validated and settled at accept, swept at 120 s.
top concern: Gift lane never got trade2's v2.3.3183 fight lock: a modified phone losing a PvP fight gifts its bag to a friend, emptying the killer's pile.

title: The two-sided trade window (trade2 session)
what it tracks: In-memory session: invite, offer stage, review stage, confirms, commit; staged weapons escrowed in trade2wpn: rows.
top concern: Weapon deliveries are awaited after the one-write commit; a restart between them lets the join sweep refund the weapons while gold/items already moved.

title: The order book's order (mkt_order: rest, match, cancel, expire)
what it tracks: Escrowed buy/sell orders in the GameRoom's bucket book, settled credit-first, converged by settle/refund stamps at wake.
top concern: A crossing placement is four write batches; a restart can drop the taker's escrow, or the rebuild deletes a half-settled order unpaid.

title: A credit's life: live, parked in the mailbox, drained at the join (inbox + oplog)
what it tracks: The one payout funnel: in-flight set, 48 h oplog stamps, per-box serial chain, join drain, paged prune job.
top concern: Idempotency is a 48 h journal while store listings (7 d) and market orders converge on it lazily; leftovers converged late go the wrong way.

title: An Auction House listing (store_listing: rest, bid, sale, release)
what it tracks: Listing record with sale/pendBid/pendOffer/releasing intent markers, converged by oplog reads at a lazy wake rebuild.
top concern: Item listings take the stack in one batch and write the record in the next; a restart between leaves goods gone with nothing naming them.

title: An escrowed offer on a listing
what it tracks: A buyer's gold escrowed against a listing: pending, live, think, accepted, refunded or expired after 48 h.
top concern: The offer-expiry pass counts every record and stops at the first 20 with no cursor, so offers on later listings never expire in 48 h.

title: A listing's haggle thread (store_thread:)
what it tracks: Per-listing buyer threads created on first line and dropped at every listing end, before the record.

title: Diego's public pile (shop_stock)
what it tracks: One global per-key stock count, seeded once, setting his buy price; sales save purse and pile together.

title: The bank vault (bank:<pid>, cached per session)
what it tracks: Versioned vault record with a load-once cache, failed/newer states, and opId ring; moves written with the bag.

title: The gambling tables (Hall roll, Ace coin flip, Ace item wager, hall of fame)
what it tracks: Single-event settles gated by in-memory per-player cooldown stamps; silent refusals; client panel's 6 s fallback.
top concern: No fight or place gate: a modified phone can wager its bag mid-PvP-fight; client mirror of the bounds is unpinned.

title: The /roll and /flip cadence (dice)
what it tracks: One in-memory 5 s stamp per player; the roll is a placed event; pinned client mirror.

title: A mystery piece in the bag (unrevealed to revealed)
what it tracks: Server-owned unrevealed mark on every server copy of a piece, cleared by reveal, wear or join.
top concern: Seven writers across six files; trade/market/store/salvage doors deliberately ignore the mark and ship the grade to the other party.

title: Salvage and the grade ladder (normal to godly)
what it tracks: A piece's quality raised only by a same-metal essence; salvage turns it into bars; 250 ms per-player stamp.

title: The wooden-greatsword conversion (old to metal)
what it tracks: Idempotent rewrite of weapon blobs by migration v20 plus heals at the post and the shelves' rebuilds.

title: A score checkpoint on the chain (sign, nonce, broadcast, receipt)

what it tracks: Six time-gated limiters (farm, cook rate and floor, perfect claims, recovery strike, trap arms and catches).

title: The worn amulet: crafted, gem-slotted, never taken off
what it tracks: ps.amulet replaced by each craft (old row kept), gem overwritten on a re-slot; nuggets and bars counters.
top concern: Craft converts gold (forfeited in a No man's land loss) into a worn amulet (kept) with no fight lock or position check.

what it tracks: Join-time heal moving lifeSkills.gems into bag keys; gemsCaptured one-time claim; gemsUnpaid owed set-XP.

title: Gem economy mode: crack and combine, or the old cut
what it tracks: The shardcrack flag flips crack/combine, the old one-gem cut and the kill-roll raw gem together.

title: Weapon hardening: H0-H5, temper, pity or keep
what it tracks: Per-weapon hardness and failure streak; hardenkeep switch chooses keep-on-failure or the temper pity band.
top concern: hardenkeep thrown mid-session drops levels a page told the player a failure would keep (caps read at join).

title: Trap mark: armed, judged at the kill, rolled
what it tracks: One trap mark per player on a Wheel monster for 15 s, judged at the killing blow, rolled per share.

title: Fish log and biggest-fish boards
what it tracks: Per-player catches-to-weigh and bests, cached with dirty/locked flags; the room's per-species top-ten boards.

title: One-handed swords become greatswords
what it tracks: Idempotent sword-to-greatsword conversion with a was mark, via migration v19 and four boundary doors.
top concern: With swordconvert:false the Forge mints swords that no later door converts once the record's v19 migration has run.

title: Life-skill feature modes: flags read live, caps frozen at join
what it tracks: About 29 live flags change server rules per message while each page keeps the caps it joined with.
top concern: gearlevel thrown mid-session: page predicts an equip the worker silently refuses, and nothing puts it back.

title: A minted piece in flight: ledger and phone bag, not yet the server's list
what it tracks: Forged, chest, dropped and quest armour live in the ledger and the phone's bag until the next join adopts them.
top concern: forge_armor mid-fight turns forfeitable bars into armour a No man's land loss cannot take; no fight lock or position check.

title: Party invite handshake (invite, accept, decline, expire)

top concern: Docs say per-sender-session; the key is the stable player id pair, so an invite survives the inviter's reconnect (harmless).

what it tracks: Who is in which party, across _parties, _partyByPlayer, _partyUnknownIds and party:/party_by_player: storage, under three live switches.

title: Party leader succession (leave, restart, idle hand-on)

top concern: The idle hand-on needs seen > 0; converted clans give offline members seen 0, so a never-returning former clan leader leads forever.

title: Party member presence: online, away, offline, last seen
what it tracks: A member's awaySince and seen stamps, derived away/off/dead flags, and the 2 s roster re-echo while anyone is on.
top concern: The disconnect's seen is memory-only and joins write it at most every 6 h, so after a deploy last-seen can be hours early.

title: Alliance status hysteresis, board row and lazy index
what it tracks: Whether a party is an alliance (20 active to become, 15 to stay), its board row, and the lazy index.
top concern: A party in memory that nobody is on is never re-counted; the board trusts its stale on while row-only parties apply DROP.

title: Alliance name and tag with a 24 h rename wait
what it tracks: An alliance's name, tag and renamedAt: first naming free, then once a day, unique across alliances and clans.

title: Alliance war: declare, score, resolve and pay, cooldown
what it tracks: A 30-minute war between two alliances, scored by No man's land kills, paid by opId, then an hour's rest.
top concern: Docs say a war 'stands still' under alliance:false, but endTime is absolute: the clock runs and it resolves the moment the switch is back.

title: Alliance tag as worn (state, session data, peers)
what it tracks: The allyTag a player wears, mirrored on ps, session data and every phone, re-asserted at roster changes, joins and echoes.

title: Clans become parties (one-way conversion pass)
what it tracks: Each stored clan turned into a stored party, or dissolved, at the first join after a deploy.
top concern: Offline members get seen 0, so the party's idle-leader hand-on never fires for a converted clan's absent leader (S8-3).

title: Clan registry, invites and wars (pre-alliance clans)
what it tracks: The old clan membership, pending clan invites and lawless-zone clan wars, live only under clanparty:false.
top concern: Retired: clan creation debits 500 gold then awaits two separate puts; a restart between keeps the debit with no clan.

title: Friend requests and friendships (stored handshake)
what it tracks: Stored friends:<pid> docs with list, incoming and outgoing requests; request, accept, decline, remove.
top concern: No withdraw and no expiry for an outgoing request: requests to players who never answer fill the 25 slots for good (too-many-requests).

title: Offline DM backlog
what it tracks: A capped mailbox of DMs to an offline friend, delivered once at their next join and deleted.
top concern: Delivered-once: a backlog sent into a closing socket is lost (deliberate).

title: Chat guard per connection: social allowance and repeat memory
what it tracks: session.chatGuard: token allowance for room chat, emotes and party chat, and a 30 s repeat memory for room/area lines.
top concern: Room chat spends its token before cleaning and the repeat check; party chat only once the line is real (minor drift).

title: Chat lane bucket (area chat, whispers, friend DMs)
what it tracks: A per-player token bucket shared by area chat, whispers and friend DMs, in memory.
top concern: _laneBuckets is never pruned (one entry per player id for the worker's life) and drops the fractional refill unlike the other buckets.

title: Server mute list (stored, cached, paced writes)
what it tracks: A muter's chat_mute doc: cached at join for the fan-out, edits written at a pace, flushed at close.
top concern: A change past the burst waits in a timer up to 10 s; a deploy inside that window loses it.

title: Abuse reports (context ring, rate gate, stored report)
what it tracks: A chat report: the server's copy of recent lines, a per-reporter rate gate, stored until dismissed or 30 days old.
top concern: _chatReportLog trims only on the same reporter's next report (tiny, deliberate in-memory budget).

title: Held pose (sit, sleep, dance) and the emote relay
what it tracks: ps.po on the server and S._pose on the phone: a held pose until a real move or a stand-up message.
top concern: No server path clears ps.po at a death or respawn; a hidden-tab sleeper killed keeps po and peers keep snoring at the corpse.

title: Look relay baseline (whole, deltas, whole every minute)
what it tracks: session._look: what every phone was last told of a player's look, so a track relays only what changed.

title: Feedback board: rate windows, vote toggle, crash ring
what it tracks: Per-claimed-id hourly windows, a ticket's per-voter up/down toggle, and a 200-report crash ring in the Feedback DO.
top concern: Public route takes playerId from the body: anyone votes as any id (unlimited) and the hourly limit is per claimed id.

title: Leaderboard rows and the room's report throttle
what it tracks: session._lbSig/_lbAt decide when the room re-posts a player's row; rows older than 7 days drop off the answer.
top concern: player: rows are never deleted and every public GET /top lists all of them.

title: Bot fingerprint record: hydrate, score, caps, flag, put, evict
what it tracks: Per-identity anti-bot record in a 128-slot map: hydrated at join, decaying score, hour caps, flags, paced botstat: writes.
top concern: An evicted online player's record is recreated fresh by the next hit and its next put overwrites stored flags, counters, hour count and sig.

title: Server bot signals and the optional Turnstile re-check
what it tracks: rec.sig: walk, gesture, cook, reflex, rooted, streak and route measures, a score, a flag, and a re-check owed.
top concern: reverify is re-armed at every evaluation while the score stands, so a flagged player is asked at every join, not once a flag (switch off).

top concern: The server's rung is never sent at join; after a character restart (claims kept) the panel offers a rung already paid.

title: A story quest's status (none, offered, taken, handed in) and its objective counter
what it tracks: Per-quest status absent/available/active/turnedIn plus counted objectives; server-owned, predicted by the phone before the answer.

top concern: Status set, then the unfit-weapon inbox credit awaited, then saved: a restart there can duplicate a weapon; quest armour exists server-side only as a row.

what it tracks: Per-player achv record cache (got/n/dg/t, locked) with grants at every settling site, a join sweep and a title.
top concern: Mail drain writes `got` before an awaited gear row and the rpg save: a restart loses the arena's 500 AP; dev clear re-pays AP.

what it tracks: aponce mark loaded before mail, set by either road, saved in the rpg blob's own write.

title: The monster codex record: counted in memory, written on a fact, a timer or the close
what it tracks: Per-player kill counts per kind with dirty/savedAt flush on the next kill past 60 s and on close.
top concern: No tick flush: dirty counts wait for the next kill or the close, so a pause then a deploy loses them.

title: The pets record: loaded, locked, moved in once, written at once or on a timer
what it tracks: Per-player pets record cache with the one-time old-pet move, dirty journal, xpFrac, rate window, admin look lever.
top concern: Old pets' move: record put unawaited while the rpg blob empties lifeSkills.pets later; a failed record put loses them.

title: A pet's life: caught, held a day, out with you or put away, traded, released
what it tracks: Per pet: trade hold, legacy flag, active or idle, level capped at Trapping, taken and given by trade, store, mail.

title: The free daily spin's run: ready, spun (a pot at rest), doubled, taken, lost, kept at midnight
what it tracks: Daily free spin, bonus spins, an open pot doubled or taken, paid at the day's end, opId per act.
top concern: Pay closes the pot in memory, saved two awaits later; a restart there leaves it open, and after the 48 h prune it pays again.

title: The daily-rewards record cache and the day's turnover (load, dirty, save, forget; midnight online)
what it tracks: Per-player daily_rewards cache, dirty map, turnover lock, pending news and kept-pot maps, tick flush and midnight turnover.
top concern: Turnover pays and must be saved by every caller; only __drTurning guards _drNewDayOnline, not the acts' own turnovers.

what it tracks: Daily board of three quests, counted signals, paid in one run with the record, one reroll; off unless dailyquests.
top concern: Dormant; a stale-day signal is dropped and a refused reroll answers nothing if it is turned back on.

title: The season track and its streak freezes (dropped: only the drop's mail-out runs)
what it tracks: Season stars, tiers claimed or mailed, overflow spins; dropped, so each turnover mails reached unclaimed tiers once.
top concern: Freeze grants have no stamp and tier mail-outs rely on 48 h stamps; a restart before the record save can grant them again.

what it tracks: Opens daily chests already in bags (none minted since v2.3.3140); bag count re-checked after awaits, opId stamped.
top concern: opId stamp awaited before the save: a restart drops the same-opId retry silently; no loss, no double.

title: A trained combat skill's XP and level, and the points each level mints (prog3)
what it tracks: Per-skill XP and level 1-100, lane and shared point minting, character level by best skill or sum.
top concern: Shared points mint by the onelevel flag at each level-up, the re-deal by one-level always, the reset by the flag then; flips mix rules.

title: The prog3 block's shape and its one-time stamps (atk split, elem fold, luck fold, ppl, spl, olr, ms)
what it tracks: Six one-way idempotent folds run by migrations and again by _sanitizeProg3 at each join, held by stamps.
top concern: Any stamp the sanitizer forgets to carry turns a one-time grant or re-deal into one per join.

title: Spending points and the free reset (pool, lane pools, shared pool; the reset's minute)
what it tracks: One point a prog3_allocate from lane, shared or spare pools; a free reset refused mid-fight, dead, or within a minute.
top concern: The reset refuses fights and the dead, the spend checks neither; the reset's minute is memory-only and a reconnect skips it.

title: pets.js: the retired capture, and the pet fetch's pickup range
what it tracks: pet_capture always answers retired; a viaPet pickup range of 600 or 240 px by pile and flag.

title: The legacy T2 build-point economy (t2Flat accumulator, spend-level pricing)
what it tracks: Old grid build accumulator, replayed at join and echoed, read as 0 for every prog3 player.
top concern: Dead weight kept for rollback: replayed at every join and echoed on every player_state.

top concern: GUILD_QUESTS is keyed by array index into stored claim counts; a reorder re-maps every claim.

title: The World Builder's square panel: pick, template, picture waiting, keep, redo
what it tracks: Which square is open, its template, the picture waiting to be kept, painted or redoing (dormant loop).
top concern: async select() never re-checks the selected square: a slow earlier select paints its template and prompt under a later square's title.

title: The World Builder's stored work across four stores: keep, redo, re-fuse, restore, backup
what it tracks: The project record, raw pictures, fused chunks and thumbnail in IndexedDB, written by keep, redo, rebuild, restore.

what it tracks: S.busy and the full-screen overlay around every long job; the toast's hide timer.
top concern: redo, backup, restore, rebuild and style key rely on the overlay, not S.busy; a keyboard press gets past it.

title: The fused world's chunk cache: loaded, written (dirty), flushed
what it tracks: LRU of 512 px fused tiles with a dirty set, flushed to IndexedDB one put each.
top concern: no in-flight de-dupe: two loads of one tile can drop a write; unreachable while keep runs under the overlay.

title: The style key: none, saved, replaced (and read by the two other studios)
what it tracks: The map's style key picture kept in the World Builder's misc store, read by Ground and Object Studios.
top concern: set in memory before its put: a refused put shows Saved until reload; open studio tabs keep the old key.

title: Has the plan moved under a painted square? and the backup nag
what it tracks: Per-square planKey against today's plan, whole-plan hash for old records, squares kept since last backup.
top concern: a cancelled backup download still silences the nag.

title: The studios' IndexedDB store: opened at version 1 for ever, one transaction per call
what it tracks: Each studio database's creation, its stores, open and close; one transaction per get/put.
top concern: version fixed at 1: a store added to any studio's list never appears in an existing database (NotFoundError, no upgrade path).

title: The ground worker's life and its one message line
what it tracks: Worker loaded, initialising, ready; requests in order on one promise chain; idle block building when empty.
top concern: throws off the line (whereIs, idleBlock) reach the game's onerror, which rejects every piece in flight as if the worker died.

title: A ground picture's download: queued, downloading, here, backing off, chased
what it tracks: Per swatch file: quiet or urgent in the line, four downloads, 15 s limit, backoff, LRU of files.
top concern: a queued prefetch promoted to urgent never calls pump(): it waits behind three prefetches with the reserved line idle, and its piece goes partial.

title: A piece laid short, and laid again when its picture comes (partial, lacking, owed, got, relay)
what it tracks: Worker marks a piece partial with lacking pictures, says got when one arrives; renderer relays it.
top concern: got means the file came, not that it will unpack or stay: lean eviction makes a refetch loop; unreadable counts as mended.

title: A ground picture in the worker: unpacked, let go, squeezed cold, thawed, calmed, or unreadable for good
what it tracks: Decoded LRU, lean squeeze to cold and thaw, calmed water, and the terminal unreadable set.
top concern: any unpack exception, including a canvas or bitmap refused at the memory ceiling, marks the swatch unreadable for the whole visit.

title: What the worker learns once, at its start: ground manifest, objects manifest, baked objects, studio tiles
what it tracks: Swatch sources, footstep choices, objects with manifest, bake and doors, fixed for the visit at ready.
top concern: init fetches have no timeout or retry: one failed manifest means plan-colour ground or no buildings and doors all visit; a hang stalls ready.

title: The blocks the worker keeps, and the game's copy of their walls
what it tracks: Worker's built blocks (16/48 nearest the last where) and the game's 96 by arrival; missing reads open.
top concern: walls stay right only while the game's 96 outlast the worker's kept blocks; untested invariant, near() fed only by where.

title: Ground Studio picture slots (upload, keep, finish, remove) and the game reading them
what it tracks: Each swatch version's upload, seamless tile and finished picture across five maps and two IndexedDB stores.
top concern: Game worker replaces the game copy per id with any studio entry: owner's phone hides game versions or newer chat-added pictures others see.

title: Ground Studio "made from an older prompt" marks (brief and time stamps)
what it tracks: Per-version brief and time stamps deciding which pictures and blends are marked to make again.
top concern: Zip keeps one madeFrom per swatch and restore stamps A, B and E with it, and re-stamps every time: stale marks lost or invented.

title: Ground Studio "seamless the new way" remake stamp
what it tracks: One-time remake of saved seamless tiles behind the stored prepMade version string.

title: Ground Studio shared palette: automatic, frozen, or each swatch its own (dormant)
what it tracks: Shared ground palette mode (automatic or frozen), pinned to per-swatch own colours since v2.3.2961.
top concern: Restore always saves the palette, wiping a pre-v2.3.2961 frozen palette if ownColours ever returns to 0.

title: Ground Studio preview: lay the ground, then paint (compose loop)
what it tracks: Preview compose dedupe: one in-flight promise plus a dirty flag, re-checked until the laid ground covers the view.
top concern: Preview's 1024 game px phone height predates the game's zoom-outs (now about 1330): about 1.3x zoomed in.

title: Ground Studio page boot (S.ready) and its handlers
what it tracks: Page boot: load every saved picture, then render and wire all buttons.
top concern: One saved picture whose tile and upload both fail to decode throws out of loadAll; nothing is wired, so no backup, restore or remove.

title: Ground Studio footstep choices and the walk player
what it tracks: Owner's per-ground footstep sound choices (planned or changed) and the page's lazily built audio player.
top concern: Restore replaces all step choices with the zip's ({} when none) while merging pictures: newer choices silently lost, owner's game follows.

title: Object Studio: where each object's pieces come from (its own picture wins, else its sheet)
what it tracks: Per object source: none, made from its sheet, or its own picture, which always wins.
top concern: Restore and the MADE re-make keep an own picture that no longer cuts: 'not made', no Remove, sheet shadowed, left out of backups.

title: Object Studio sheet pictures: found, named, re-read, removed
what it tracks: Sheet pictures: parts found by count, auto-named in reading order, renamed by the owner, re-read on finder change.
top concern: Owner's sheet names survive restore only if the same part count is found; a keyOut change (MADE) silently replaces them with guesses.

title: Object Studio boot and its once-only remakes (MADE, FINDER, SIZES_BASE)
what it tracks: Page boot and three stored stamps that drive one-time remakes of sizes, sheets and pieces.
top concern: An unreadable stored piece PNG with matching stamps throws (no try) out of loadAll; no buttons are wired, so no backup or restore.

title: Object Studio stage: the one object shown at game size
what it tracks: The one object shown at game size beside the bro: hidden, drawing, showing.
top concern: 'As big as on your phone' uses the pre-v2.3.2997 view (1024 px); the game shows about 1330, so the stage is about 1.36x too big.

title: Object Studio "made from an older prompt" marks (prompt fingerprints)
what it tracks: Prompt fingerprint per object picture and per sheet, with a size-only case for grown buildings.

title: Style Lab preview: open, walk, close (the rAF loop)
what it tracks: Full-screen preview overlay: opening, open with its rAF loop, switching looks, closed.
top concern: Closing during openPreview's awaits still starts the rAF loop, which draws a window-size canvas every frame behind the hidden overlay.

title: Style Lab saved work: pictures, scores and settings, and their caches
what it tracks: Lab pictures in IndexedDB or memory, scores and settings in localStorage, two at-keyed caches.
top concern: No busy overlay: two quick uploads to one slot keep whichever finishes last and leak the other's object URL.

title: Style Lab scene: the bro's walk, the demo stroll, and the scene's build cache
what it tracks: Stand-in screen: bro steered, resting, strolling or walled in; device-size build cache; weather drops.
top concern: Scene, ground preview and object stage hard-code the game's 1024 px phone height; the game now shows about 1330 after the zoom-outs.

title: Studio toasts, the busy overlay, and the download links (all three pages)
what it tracks: Per-page toast timer, full-screen busy overlay used as the edit mutex, revoked download links.

title: The pet's follow, fetch run and loot vacuum
what it tracks: Your pet's follow / run-to-pile / come-back phases and the per-pile viaPet pickup ask.
top concern: BroTown passes petFetchStep a hoisted, still-undefined `now`, so give-up, way-back, skip and look timers never fire.

title: The local player's death and respawn
what it tracks: S._dying / _deathStart / respawnTimer: dead, respawn-invulnerable, alive; server and three legacy local paths.
top concern: Three hand-copied respawn sequences survive beside respawn.js's 'ONE copy', skipping art release, npcs reset, Wheel trip, and still docking gold locally.

title: The renderer's life: init, retry, rebuild window, owed rebuild

what it tracks: bootPhase checking/login/create/null plus showIntro, gating five effects and the two roads into joinTown.
top concern: The creator road runs joinTown twice: PLAY calls it, then the auto-join effect fires because _autoJoined is only set inside it.

title: Quest banner queue and the level-up / achievement slots
what it tracks: Quest banner preempt-or-queue (cap 3) with per-kind holds, held behind the loading gate.

title: Which windows are open: thirty booleans, three lists
what it tracks: ~30 show* / panel flags, closeAllMenus, _desktopCloseAll and _anyPanelOpen feeding S._uiBusy and uiBusyBus.
top concern: _anyPanelOpen omits clanInvite and every bus-driven window, so the chat feed and burst button stay up over them.

title: stats_update report-on-change with a last-signature stamp
what it tracks: Client reports derived build (armor, skill tracks, grids, seeded T1) when its signature changes.
top concern: The signature is stamped before a send the shim silently drops while reconnecting, so a change made then is lost on rejoin.

title: The local rpg cache (bt_rpg): seed, migrate, overwrite
what it tracks: bt_rpg loaded and shape-guess migrated into S.rpg before the worker's player_state replaces it.
top concern: The cache carries no shape version; migrations infer old shapes from field presence. The btRpc load road is dead code.

title: May I move this frame: walk-freeze flags and their copies
what it tracks: Veils, loading, race line, sled, stun, loot freeze and death that zero the stick or the walk.
top concern: Sprint's 'moving' omits _avatarArtHold and raceHeld, so on Lil Bro's start line predicted stamina drains while the worker bills nothing.

title: The two touch discs: painted / pressable / lit / hot / ghost
what it tracks: Per-frame resolver for the right contextual disc and left stick visibility, press-ability and face.

title: A lit campfire: strike, fire, keep-alive, burn out
what it tracks: Client-local firemaking and campfire lifecycle, pushed alive while cooking, cleared on zone change.

title: The harvest in progress (S._extraction) tick and cancels
what it tracks: Extraction waiting to ready via worker hits or timer; cancelled by stick, reach, node loss or zone change.
top concern: A locked try waits on Infinity until its plan lands; a lost gather_hits leaves WAIT on the disc until you move.

title: A townsperson's frame: racing, companion, day-walk or wander
what it tracks: Per-NPC wander/companion/chat timers and the quest badge derived each frame from quest state.

title: The walk-up dialogue latch (?npcprox only)
what it tracks: Proximity opener's {npc, ready} latch with open/clear hysteresis, dormant since tap-only talking.

title: The clan war's local clock
what it tracks: S._activeClanWar active, ended, cleared; ended both by the phone's timer and the worker's clan_war_end.
top concern: With caps.clans the local clock still shows WAR WON and a pay line and can pre-empt or swallow the worker's verdict.

title: GameApp's sound keeper: unlock, away, re-arm on tap
what it tracks: Visibility, pageshow, focus and a late heartbeat arm BT_AUDIO's session reclaim and kick for the next gesture.

title: Small dead or dormant machines in this half
what it tracks: Tutorial steps, farm-bed sleep, worn-armour toggle, hostile poll, NFT lookup, town music interval.
top concern: Dormant client-authoritative writes (full HP, buffs, free armour art) wake if tile 15 or InventoryPanel returns.

title: Per-frame action ticks: roll, lunge, whirlwind, gust, climb, jump latch
what it tracks: Nullable in-progress move records ended by arrival, window, death or zone change.

title: Canvas sizing: resize, watchdog and iOS page lock
what it tracks: Edge-triggered resize plus a level-triggered watchdog sharing bandFootprint, standing down while typing.

title: A tab left open across a deploy (staleBuild)
what it tracks: buildWatch mismatch: reload on a pre-game screen, else the update banner.

title: The idle clock and the AWAY flag
what it tracks: S._lastInputAt drives the page's idle logout and the aw flag the worker trusts for its sweep.

title: Who this page plays as: S.myId worked out at mount
what it tracks: Guest, adopted, minted or corrected identity; every key change otherwise reloads.
top concern: _takeKeyId corrects S.myId in place while other key changes reload; earlier readers can disagree (no live breakage found).

title: React mirrors of the loop's 'what is near me'
what it tracks: Nearest node/door/hall/farm buttons pushed to React on change; one room picture warmed.

title: Device-local lists and counters (bt_stats, bt_clan, friends)
what it tracks: Per-device stats, clan cache and social lists restored at mount with no version.
top concern: visitedBuildings returns as an Array (no .size); bt_clan is not a per-character cache key, so a switch shows the old clan until join.

title: Client-local gather node respawn
what it tracks: Harvested nodes revive on respawnAt only while the worker is not authoritative for nodes.

title: Character creator's preview states and randomize flair
what it tracks: Camera framing, facing, drag-rotate and a 3-step randomize interval over store-mirror trait pairs.

title: The chat composer and the log's change bump
what it tracks: chatOpen, input value with a ref mirror, send and refocus; one wrapper bumps the feed's bus.

title: The slime proximity hum's looping source
what it tracks: Buffer load, one looping source and a gain following the nearest slime within 250 px.
top concern: After BT_AUDIO rebuilds its AudioContext the slot keeps the closed context's nodes and never recreates them: slimes silent until reload.

title: The black-screen watchdog (pixel strikes, rebuild, reload)
what it tracks: Samples the world canvas every 5 s; first-join one strike, play two strikes rebuild, four strikes reload.
top concern: A sample asked before a renderer rebuild is collected after it from the old detached canvas, charging a false dark strike.

title: The door: boot phase, auto-join and the address's door words
what it tracks: bootPhase checking/login/create/null, the auto-join latch and URL door words route a page to door, creator or world.
top concern: Creator ENTER runs joinTown twice (handler, then auto-join effect); DeviceScreen's Login Key reload drops ?guest=1 and the page's switches.

title: The straight-in road: resume snapshot, recovery reload and its cap
what it tracks: bt_resume snapshot, bt_resume_now/spot and a 2-per-5-minute reload cap carry a tab back into the world after a reload.
top concern: Typing another character's key clears only bt_rpg/bt_stats, so the reload replays the previous character's snapshot into the look stores.

title: The loading gate: is the world on screen, and its held messages
what it tracks: worldIn, up, readyAt and a 24-deep held list decide when world messages may show after a loading screen.
top concern: On ?debug=1 markWorldIn is never called, so every banner and toast is held forever; an older __introLiftedAt gate coexists.

title: The onboarding referee: one tutorial voice at a time, and Skip tutorial
what it tracks: Module flags pace the welcome plate, coach cards and install card; Skip tutorial silences them per browser.
top concern: QuestCoach's retire path hides a showing card without noteCoach(false), leaving _coachUp true so the install card never shows until reload.

title: The banner slots: quest plate queue, level-up, collect and achievement toasts
what it tracks: React message slots with timed expiry and a 3-deep quest-plate queue promoted by the 500 ms interval.
top concern: questMsgRef updates only on render, so two queued notices in one tick both see the old slot and the second stomps the first.

title: The move broadcast gate (rest packet, keepalive, quiet phone, shield and gear edges)
what it tracks: Ten send-now triggers and a dozen last-sent stamps decide when this player's move, gather_node and track relays go.
top concern: Facing marked sent by the outer gate even when no move went (no channel, quiet-held); healed by the next keepalive.

title: The idle clock: away flag and the client's own idle logout
what it tracks: One input timestamp drives the aw flag and a 2-minute client hang-up backed by the worker's packet sweep.

title: Holding the shield: per-frame guard window and the computer's right-button toggle
what it tracks: 250 ms rolling shieldEnd, mouse/lock steering and the right-click toggle around shieldToggle's raise/drop.
top concern: BLOCK_COSTS_STAMINA is a hand-mirrored client/worker switch; a phone's toggled guard survives the page going away.

title: Touch input arbitration: left stick, right zone, the disc, and letting go
what it tracks: Three touch surfaces with finger ids, tap/drag/flick classifiers and shared attack flags, released when the page goes away.
top concern: touchcancel runs the same handlers as touchend, so a system-cancelled touch can forward a click, cycle weapons, open chat or cast a special.

title: Tap-to-lock and the computer's press/click pairing
what it tracks: S.lockedTarget tap writers (promote, toggle, double click, duel/NML/party/spar branches) plus press-to-click dedupe stamps.
top concern: Canvas onTouchEnd keeps its own monster hit test with no player branch, and its 600 ms stamp swallows any following click.

title: The weapon in hand: active slot, the session latch, and the swap preview
what it tracks: rpg.activeSlot mirrored with the worker; after any swap a session latch makes the phone ignore the worker's slot.
top concern: The worker's own repair to melee when the active bow/staff is unequipped never reaches a latched phone, which keeps an empty slot.

title: Warps onto the farm: hand-written zone entries beside the zone machine
what it tracks: Four copied blocks write currentZone='farm_home' with their own clear lists instead of the zone machine's.
top concern: None of the farm warps calls clearZoneLocalFx, so campfire, in-flight light, extraction and peer projectiles survive the trip.

title: Lighting a fire: the in-flight light and the client-only campfire
what it tracks: A 700 ms lighting phase then a 45 s zone-stamped client campfire; the log is paid on the worker.
top concern: A refused firemaking_request still plays out and lights a usable local campfire; only the log comes back.

title: The arena's background poll and the page's own bet payout
what it tracks: An HTTP poll latches involvement and the current match; legacy page bet payouts only without caps.sponsor.
top concern: Out-of-order poll answers can re-set _arenaMatch, which steers the quiet phone's move cadence until the next poll.

title: Timed effects on the HUD: worker buff timers mirrored, page's own on old workers
what it tracks: Absolute buff end-times from the worker drive chips and client math against the phone's own clock.
top concern: No clock-skew correction (unlike farmBus serverNow and dailyRewards _skew): a wrong phone clock shows or drops buffs the worker still applies.

title: The 500 ms mirror of the loop's surroundings into React
what it tracks: Copies near door/hall/shut door/clan invite/dungeon mouth/farm spots and the player list into React state.

title: Door and prompt buttons that act on touchstart AND on the click behind it
what it tracks: Workshop, Pet House and Wheel dungeon prompts bind both onTouchStart and onClick (TRAPS §131).
top concern: Dungeon Workshop opens on touchstart; the emulated click then lands on its .bt-inspect backdrop and closes it, geometry permitting.

title: The building card and the one-panel rule (shop drawer, bottom sheet)
what it tracks: buildingPanel modal slot; effects close Diego's drawer when any panel or the sheet opens.

title: Rare windows' code, fetched on first open (lazyPanel)
what it tracks: Per-window module loader: shared promise, one cache-busting retry, a Couldn't-open card with Reload and Close.

title: Eating from the bag: the predicted bite and the fight's one-bite cooldown
what it tracks: Predicted consume and heal plus a client copy of the worker's in-fight bite cooldown, corrected by refusals.

title: Resting: Sleep button and E, the worker's rest, and the page's old one
what it tracks: With caps.rest the bed and Hotel ask the worker; the page-side restore and bed-tile sleep bar are legacy.
top concern: Old-worker branch and bed-tile sleep restore bars on the page; unreachable now (caps.rest true, no tile 15 on the farm).

title: The tour prompt and the teach-by-doing step banner
what it tracks: Old seven-step tutorial banner and its opt-in prompt; hard-off since v2.3.1593.
top concern: Dormant copy describes the retired map and step 4 fires at once in the Wheel; harmless while off.

title: Old lands' zone actions, the endgame portal and the death-scatter timer
what it tracks: Raft, torch, sled, snow and Dark Sanctum/Light Summit portal on closed old lands; legacy death-scatter countdown.
top concern: Wood spent and zones warped on the page with no worker message, only on retired paths; portal buttons are touchstart-only.

title: Saving the page's own stats
what it tracks: bt_stats written only when changed on the 500 ms tick, bt_update_stats every 600 ticks.

title: The loading screen's way in: showIntro, body.bt-intro-up and its three gates
what it tracks: joinTown arms the clip with asset, server and Wheel-arrival gates; IntroVideo lifts it and clears the body mark.
top concern: joinTown throwing after marking the body sends the page to the door with bt-intro-up left on until a veil self-heal.

title: World map overlay: in-the-Wheel poll, open/close, frees on close
what it tracks: One open flag driven by a 300 ms Wheel poll, minimap tap, Town Hall row and the M key.
top concern: openWorldMap() sets open without the inWheel test the M-key toggler makes; harmless because the render is gated and the poll resets it.

title: World map view: first view, late town-view takeover, player's own view
what it tracks: waitTown/touched flags choose between the town view, you up close, and the player's own pan or zoom.

title: World map gestures: tap vs drag vs pinch
what it tracks: Pointer map, pinch and press holders recognise a tap (drops a pin), a drag (pans) and a pinch (zooms).

title: Map pins: two slots, drop/replace/lift, and the reached-it card
what it tracks: Per-slot row/place/armed/asked on S._mapPins, a module ask bus, a 250 ms card clock and a replace ghost.
top concern: Module-level _ask outlives its card: an unanswered 'remove' card left in the Wheel comes back on return, as its clock only checks the pin exists.

title: Map watch heartbeat for far players (presence v2)
what it tracks: Open map sends map_watch on, renewed every 4 s, off on close; the worker holds an 8 s lease.

title: World map detail tiles: fetched, held (cap 16), freed on close
what it tracks: Per-tile absent/loading/held/failed lifecycle with retry, LRU trim and a generation guard across closes.
top concern: A fetch that never settles keeps its loading slot; four such stall all later tiles for the session.

title: Harvest gesture: press, adoption, resumable meter, success
what it tracks: Which finger owns the harvest gesture, the stroke tracker and the 1.5 s meter, riding on S._extraction status.
top concern: Eight holders across five files with a history of finger-ownership fixes; the client grades 'perfect', bounded server-side; the header's 'window closes' note is stale.

title: Hold E to harvest (desktop keyboard work)
what it tracks: kb holder {down, until, raf} works the gesture at a quick pace through wind-up and window, sharing settle/finish.

title: HUD popup queue: +XP and +G flights to the card or top bar
what it tracks: S._hudPopups entries lift, fall or float, land (releasing holds) and are pruned at 1.6 s.
top concern: rAF requested every frame for the whole session (only re-render skipped); the retired v2.3.1638 bar code still computes state.

title: Skill card's held XP number: frozen in flight, then counts up
what it tracks: Per skill: tracking, holding (count, 2.1 s failsafe) and counting (420 ms ease) of the displayed XP.
top concern: A popup pruned before mounting never calls landXp; a steady gain stream refreshes heldAt, freezing a card until 2.1 s after the last.

title: Kill XP inbound tokens and the top bar's landing pulse
what it tracks: One idempotent token per kill flight holds the bar's +N; landing pulses via attributes on html.

title: Level-up bursts: two-slot bus and the levelUpMsg funnel
what it tracks: Two fixed column slots, retire-by-seq, bounded dedup; fed by BroTown's levelUpMsg from many setters.
top concern: Loading gate only on window._setLevelUpMsg; prog3_level, combat_credit and character levels use the raw setter, so bursts and their sting play under a veil.

title: One level-up burst's life: clock, measure-once, bubbles, sting
what it tracks: Self-driven rAF clock from msg.ts, measure-once layout, one-shot points bubbles, 450 ms sting debounce.
top concern: Hidden tab holds the slot until return; a replaced combat burst flies its bubbles from the unmount fallback (deliberate).

title: Zone-entry and land banners: one element, a timer timeline, dwell watch
what it tracks: Single body element, timers guarded by _playing, 45 s repeat; Wheel lands after a 600 ms dwell.
top concern: _wl.shown latched before playZoneBanner can refuse (no dock rect), losing that crossing's banner; the land watch asks no loading gate.

title: Guide arrow: four once-a-character lessons
what it tracks: A 250 ms ticker shows weapon, swap, points and Mayor lessons by priority; done marks are stored per device.
top concern: 'Once a character' is per device: on any new browser a veteran gets the swap lesson again for 10 s; seen-time resets on reload.

title: Intro loading screen: four gates, then the fade
what it tracks: Minimum time, assets (20 s cap), server (no cap) and world gates feed one maybeFinish latch.
top concern: The fade's setTimeout(finish) is not cancelled on unmount, so onComplete can run after the overlay was taken away.

title: Login Key form: idle, checking, confirm, switching
what it tracks: Declared phase string for key entry: check via POST /api/account/login, confirm in-game, switch reloads.
top concern: An in-flight check outlives its closed modal: on the login door, backing out mid-check still switches character when the answer lands.

title: Login Key card: the Copied! flash
what it tracks: Two-state copy feedback with a 1.6 s timer and a select-and-copy fallback.

title: Mystery reveal ceremony: queue, staged spin, hold, next
what it tracks: Module queue feeds an overlay: spinning stages, landed, held 1.7 s, then onDone and the next one.
top concern: Pump takes from the queue inside a setItem updater (impure); a double-invoked updater would drop a reveal, bounded by revealBag's time limit.

title: World is full: waiting screen, endless retry, Try now
what it tracks: Room-full refusal phase of wsClient's connection: fixed-cadence retries behind an updating screen.
top concern: Try now calls connect() during an in-flight handshake: sockets overlap, onclose never checks this===ws, and orphans can veil or supersede the live session.

title: Your bro is still in that fight: linger wait and timed reconnect
what it tracks: linger_wait/4010 phase: countdown screen and one reconnect timer until the body is gone.
top concern: Socket-effect teardown hides the room-full screen but not this one, leaving a countdown over a cleared timer until the next answer.

title: Final refusal screens: not the official site; another device / key
what it tracks: Terminal origin/device/key phases from join_rejected closes 4015/4016/4017; exits are reload, door or real site.

title: Star cue: big star shrinks onto the minimap's new quest star
what it tracks: lastKey dedupe of the quest target and one live animated element, held while a loading screen is up.
top concern: lastKey is latched before the box check, so a new target on a frame with no box rect never plays.

title: TimedBanner: a banner that drives its own clock
what it tracks: rAF loop keyed on msg.ts re-renders the warning banner until it is ms old, then nothing.

title: Swallow the click of a tap that closed its window
what it tracks: One armed {x, y, at} eats that tap's mousedown/mouseup/click; ends on click, 700 ms or a new press.

title: Tap-to-dismiss and the UI sound delegate: tap-vs-drag recognisers
what it tracks: Per-surface moved flag and a page-wide last-press record decide tap or drag by slop.
top concern: The sound delegate tracks one pointer; a second finger's press silences the first finger's button tap.

title: Player portraits in lists: bounded cache with in-flight dedupe
what it tracks: Per look: absent, compositing, cached URL or null; 48 entries, oldest evicted.
top concern: A transient composite failure is cached as null, so that look shows the letter disc for the session; the mounted guard is a stale closure.

title: Pet sheet for portraits: loaded once, retried, then held
what it tracks: Promise-dedupe Image loader with retry on error; each portrait redraws on its look signature.
top concern: After the first portrait the 768x448 pet sheet stays referenced for the session, beside the world's copy.

title: Elemental status chips and the wore-off sound
what it tracks: 150 ms poll renders time-gated S._*Until statuses from the ROWS table; a since-map cues their end.
top concern: clearElemStatuses on a zone change plays the 'wore off' cue walking through a door (only death is excluded).

title: Mayor Bro welcome video (dormant)
what it tracks: Playing/closed greeting with a once-per-browser flag; nothing sets showMayorGreeting.

title: Sprite HP bar damage ghost and flash (no callers)
what it tracks: Ghost hold/drain and flash on a rAF loop for a DOM HP bar that nothing renders.

title: Layout mode: upright column, computer wide, or one band
what it tracks: Boot-time layout choice (address, tab, device) plus a live media query, read by deskWideActive and oneBandActive.
